notes.title: Thanksgiving Update
notes.content:
A new update is now available for[i] Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam!

The November Update brings many game balance adjustments alongside our special thanksgiving event...

[h2][b]GAMEPLAY HIGHLIGHTS[/b][/h2]

We've been continuing to work with our community testers and listening to feedback in general about certain classes and weapons. A big focus this update is the Pyro, reinforcing his role as more of a human tank and making him a more dangerous enemy... 

[h3][b]PYRO MANIA[/b][/h3]

Dinosaurs are now even more vulnerable to damage to when on fire, and damage over time from the molotov, flaregun and incendiary grenades is now consistent. The flamethrower has received a moderate boost to instant hit damage and the chainsaw's damage mitigation now also applies to Bruiser attacks. This means pyro can withstand more punishment and deal it out better, so we have also ramped up the flamesaw's fuel consumption rate. 

Pyro's lethality extends to his death as well, with the "Pyro Bomb" explosion now also damaging dinosaurs if he died by falling. However, there are a number of checks in place to counteract this - if a Pyro was [b]dropped[/b] by a Ptera, it will [b]NOT[/b] hurt dinosaurs. You also need to have received more than 75 fall damage to trigger an explosion, and we have reduced the amount of damage Pyro will do to his teammates when blowing [i]himself [/i]up.

[h3][b]RAPTOR POUNCE[/b][/h3]

We've made pounce a bit more viable as both an attack and a way to get around. Raptors can now aim much higher with their "charged" pounce, jumping to ledges above at more extreme angles. Max pounce distance is increased, and raptors have much less fall damage when landing from a long range pounce. 

We've also added [b]impact damage[/b] when a raptor hits a human with their pounce, which increases up to +25 bonus damage with a charged up pounce attack. This rewards raptor players who have good aim, and gives a minor consolation prize if they pounced someone with too low stamina to maul them.

[h3][b]TUPA TWEAKING[/b][/h3]

More fine tuning has been done to the Tupa, with a lower stamina cost for air dashing into humans and [b]3x faster stamina recovery speed[/b]. Stamina management remains an important part of being an effective Tupa, but is less punishing now. When fighting a Tupa, know that the back of its head is now a weakpoint.

[h3][b]STAMINA AND MORE[/b][/h3]

Finally, since stamina is an increasingly important factor in combat, all classes except for Tyrants now gain 35% faster stamina regeneration if they crouch down. These and other changes have been prompted by discussions with our community on [url=discord.gg/primalcarnage][b]Discord[/b][/url], and we'll be continuing to tweak things going forward. 

But that's not all!

Scroll further down to the full changelog below to see all the other quality of life fixes, improvements and optimizations in this update...

notes.title: HALLOWEEN HORRORS EVENT
notes.content:
A shocking new update is here for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam!
[i][b]HALLOWEEN HORRORS[/b][/i] returns to haunt you all...

Our annual frightfest brings a terrifying assortment of nightmarish new looks, along with a new game update packed with feature tweaks and improvements suggested by our scarily dedicated players!

[h1][b]Game Changes[/b][/h1]

Before we get to the gorey details of this year's special event, here are some of the highlights of our latest game update...

[h3][b]Tyrant Buffs & Bonus EXP[/b][/h3]

As of now, [i]everyone [/i]can see Tyrant buff overlays (red, green and blue for rex / spino / acro boosts). Previously these would only be visible to the dinosaur who received the buff. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/509c9124b5bf9bf293e729eba61b0066c6358458.jpg[/img]
This change allows Tyrants to see who they just gave a boost to, and lets humans know if they are fighting a buffed enemy. This is something which has been long requested, and we feel it's a positive change for everybody. 

Another tweak related to this is that Tyrants no longer automatically get bonus points for roaring. Instead, they now gain additional EXP for every dinosaur buffed within their roar's range. This rewards actually helping your team instead of just roaring for fun with nobody around.

[h3][b]Taming the Tupa[/b][/h3]

Flyers have always been one of the most problematic classes to balance, but we still keep trying. This update brings some major changes to the Tupa that make it slightly less of a nightmare to fight...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/e14d754545ed54d35a452316119147ddded4ef1c.jpg[/img]
Aside from fixing bugs and exploits with the class (such as Tupa being able to land charge hits while hovering) we have added extra sound cues for when a nearby Tupa reaches charge speed, and adjusted its stats significantly.

Tupa players will now need to watch their stamina closely, as a more noticeable chunk is taken out of it whenever you ram into humans. This coupled with higher stamina drain when sprinting means you can get into situations where ramming is not allowed due to low stam. So watch that bar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/76b9541c4a45e7d6126241b406f98bccbe1cf2d7.jpg[/img]
Remember you can conserve energy by simply diving downwards to gain speed, just angle your Tupa directly toward the ground while flying. This is more than enough to land deadly hits with Tupa's charge, allowing you to save stamina for an escape instead of relying on it to attack. To make up for higher stamina usage in general, Tupa's roar now provides much better stamina regeneration. 

[h3][b]Fixes, Fixes and More Fixes...[/b][/h3]

Circle 5 remains a small and mostly part-time team with only a couple of programmers, so we're doing our best to address issues as they're reported by the community. This update we have worked with our players to improve wherever we can, resolving many edge cases with weapons and various exploits such as being able to deal extreme knockback by hitting humans in midair as a Bruiser. 

We have now started our PlayStation beta but will continue deploying any fixes and improvements we can to the PC side while that is underway. Some small but fun changes this time include new community animations for the machete... (thanks to SpinoRavenger!)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/231MHGL.gif[/img]

Other community-requested changes include adjustments to the UI - such as a small but helpful tweak to class counts and their availability on the Class Select screen that now sees them update in realtime. Previously, they wouldn't refresh until you reopened the menu. 

There are many other fixes, for example the flamethrower failing to delete Dilo puddles (they still like to leave a smelly cloud, but don't worry about that). You can view the full changelog further down, which also includes details on a few more balance tweaks such as making Oviraptor's pounce less of an "instant win button" and reducing the deadliness of zap traps a tad now that they hit more reliably.

Capping it off is the [b][i]2023 Halloween Gift[/i][/b] - open on a server to scare up to 24 other players with spooky items! The gift opener is cursed with a spine-tingling Satanic Royal Acro for their evil deed.

notes.title: MELTDOWN 2023
notes.content:
[b]Meltdown 2023 is here! [/b]

With our latest major update we've made several spicy gameplay changes and visual tweaks, plus there's a seriously scorching selection of new looks being added. Check it out...

[h3][b]Feature Update:[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]The Bowverhaul[/b][/h2]

Having listened to feedback, we decided to radically reposition the Compound Bow's place in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/84cc4fec6af18f6f16a9fa425d786a50a64077a1.jpg[/img]
The bow is now a[i][b] primary weapon [/b][/i] and has a lot more customizability with its controls and firing modes. We've worked hard to make the bow feel easier to use, it's now less annoying to quickfire and you can continuously fire arrows without needing to take your finger off the button.

[h3][b]Alternate Control Scheme[/b][/h3]

There are [b]two[/b] control schemes for the bow now in Gameplay settings, the[i] Classic [/i](default) setup that was available previously and the new [i]Combined[/i] control method...

[b]Classic: [/b]
Charge up by holding secondary fire, tap primary fire to shoot

[b]Combined[/b]: 
Charge up by holding primary fire, release primary fire to shoot

Tap the secondary fire button in [i]Combined[/i] mode to cancel a shot, saving the arrow from being fired. 

[h3][b]Bow Auto-Fire[/b][/h3]

Three new auto-fire options for the bow in Gameplay settings control when an arrow is released...

[b]Half: [/b]Auto-fires the bow when your shot is half charged.

[b]Full: [/b]Auto-fires the bow when your shot is fully charged.

[b]Max: [/b]Default behaviour, only auto-fires when you lose control of the arrow after several seconds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NyWrMQU.gif[/img]

By selecting an auto fire option you can continuously fire by holding the primary fire button in Combined mode or primary+secondary together in Classic mode. As always, half charged shots do half damage and will not ignite targets if you are using explosive arrows.

[h3][b]Bow Rebalancing[/b][/h3]

Although a lot of actions with the bow have been made faster, we deliberately made using explosive arrows take longer now. The draw time is over twice that of regular arrows even for half charged shots, making them less of a "quick win button." 

Turning the bow into a primary weapon is as much about making it feel better to use as it is removing an overly deadly combination. The devastating one-two hit of assault cannon + explosive arrow was an incredibly lethal and unsporting tactic that Scientists could use previously. There's interesting potential for combining the DoT effects of arrows and darts with the bow's new loadout position, but it's not the crazy almost insta-kill on smaller dinosaurs that could be exploited previously.

Regular arrows have seen a modest buff to their damage output, and the bow no longer has a muzzle flash when fired, which would give away your position before.

[h2][b]GENERAL CHANGES[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]DINOSAURS[/b][/h3]

A few classes have been rebalanced a bit or received fixes / tweaks that make them handle better.

Tyrannosaurus now has new tail swipe animations, these are faster and swing out lower down while also stretching more to the side. This gives the attack greater reach and flexibility, making it much more effective and more in line with the Cerato's tail swipe.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccG5bv8.gif[/img]

It's leg day for Ceratosaurus, who can now sprint for longer without getting out of breath, andi has much faster stamina regeneration. The Pachy has also been taking notes and is now able to reach max sprint speed quicker, jump a little higher without roaring, and has a slightly more damaging knockback slide. 

Finally, the Oviraptor has been buffed with more health along with its primary attack and pounce speed being faster. This makes it a more compelling alternative to the Novaraptor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/64d88eeaef1a12348419020f1d95875811f84c5d.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]HUMANS[/b][/h3]

Aside from the bowverhaul, a few of the guns have received some TLC. We're mainly fixing some annoyances, like being unable to heavy melee with the Spaz by using the actual heavy melee key (you can still use the secondary fire button if you really want to). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/d71f37e9109e739ea8f8989d20a0501a3d971ad2.jpg[/img]
The big changes were to the burst rifle, making it a more accurate weapon, particularly when scoped. Its primary damage is slightly less, but the much better spread and falloff make up for this. The burst rifle's blade actually deals a bit *more* bleed damage, it just occurs over a shorter period of time. It's also a lot easier to melee now with the burst rifle, since firing can be interrupted.

[h3][b]A Taste of 3.0[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]VISUAL UPDATES[/b][/h2]

As part of evolving the PlayStation side of Primal, we've been adding a whole bunch of new visual flourishes to the game. These range from purely cosmetic touches to indicators that help you in combat.

When fighting as dinosaurs, successful melee or charge hits will show a more noticeable impact particle. Landing a critical hit as a dino will show a dust effect with subtle red claw swipes on impact.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uwlZxE0.gif[/img]

Several new screen overlays also appear for certain gameplay events such as healing or being stunned, and getting a kill causes a subtle flash of the screen. If you're too close to an incendiary explosion or are using the flamethrower, the screen will turn hot in addition to having new screen shake motions... 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jqVX6ya.gif[/img]

Moving fast whether as a result of SpeedGreed or by diving as a Pterosaur will cause "speed lines" to appear on the edges of your view....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/5e9377a86af6bb4142f2df2ebd00174f42b2bbb0.gif[/img]

A lot more camera shake effects have been added to many in-game actions, which add extra weight and impact when they occur. Everything from using heavy melee to being knocked back by a tailswipe or just jumping around will play unique camera motions now. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WTnOnCE.gif[/img]

We feel this connects you a bit better to the character you're playing and makes actions like chainsawing feel much more visceral. However, if you wish to disable these, the Camera Shake option in Gameplay Settings has been expanded to cover more than just Tyrant footsteps and explosions.


[b][i]Updated Feature:[/i][/b]
[h3][b]COLOUR SLIDERS[/b][/h3]

By popular demand, we have reimplemented the simple colour slider adjusters for dinosaurs!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QksXP8E.gif[/img]

These still have the same limitations as they always did, being unable to save the colours permanently. The simple sliders are remembered per-class, not per-skin, and are not guaranteed to remain selected between sessions. However, they do offer an easy way of tweaking the body and eye tones. 

For more in-depth colour customization that can be saved, the paint crafting system is still usable and can actually be combined with the simple hue sliders for interesting results. As a reminder, all paint tools can be obtained as drops now.

There are even more visual upgrades in the works for[b] 3.0[/b], not least of which will be another round of revamps to the game's maps. Expect overhauled post processing, lighting, and denser details while also being better optimized for performance when it arrives later this year!

notes.title: The Sorting Patch
notes.content:
A new patch is now available for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam. 
Today's patch includes the first iteration of our [b]team sorting[/b] system for competitive matches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/bd2b466120578143509bf12598b27111ee81cde2.png[/img]

In [b]Team Deathmatch[/b] and [b]Get to the Chopper,[/b] there is now a [i]waiting period[/i] at the start of a new [b]match[/b]. During this time while players are connecting, the game sorts teams in the background by rank to have as close as possible to an even distribution of player levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/95bc32bd2316762d0dce45b501f6d4f40b29d5b1.jpg[/img]
We've done a few rounds of initial testing with this and the response was incredibly positive. Because of that, we decided to patch it to live right away instead of waiting for the next major content update.

This change should largely address the issue of "team stacking" where many high level players would end up on a single team versus mostly low level players. We'll be monitoring with server operators to see how well it works in the wild, and are still exploring additional sorting factors such as taking into account your previous match performance.

notes.title: Patch Now Available
notes.content:
A new patch is now available for[i] Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam.

This latest patch fixes a bunch of bugs reported by the community and implements some mechanical changes that might spice up gameplay a little. 

[h3][b]TYRANT BRACE CHANGES[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/e43f30b468803e22af8aa386faa9233a7935b27d.gif[/img]

Bracing is an ability that allows Tyrants to withstand more damage while it is active. We're considering making it even stronger in future by mitigating crit shots while bracing (among other things) but today's patch modifies it to be a more deliberate stance change. 

Tyrants now have unique movement styles when bracing, created by our community animators. They are now forced to slow to regular walk speed and hunker down when using the brace ability. You can initiate a brace while sprinting, but it will cancel your sprint. The charge-up indicator for bracing has also been fixed and now displays properly for Tyrants.

[h3][b]DINOSAUR HEALING CHANGES[/b][/h3]

Kills through melee attacks such as the raptor's claw slash etc. still give health back with this patch, but it has changed to regenerate over time instead of instantly. This is similar to how picking up a medkit works as a human. The healing period is only a couple of seconds, and in most cases won't inconvenience the dinosaur. However, it does give humans a chance to stop the dino healing with enough damage. 

We also modified how Tyrants receive health from eating humans. They now regain HP incrimentally, four times over the course of the animation, instead of waiting for it to be complete before they get anything. Tyrants sharing their kills is now also more fair in terms of health restoration for each.

No changes have been made to Carno or Acro's health replenishment with their respective roars. 

[h3][b]MORE USEFUL FLARES[/b][/h3]

Pathfinder flares now have added utility by removing the Marked status from humans. If a Flyer has marked someone, the human can now run to a flare to remove the marking outlines. Anyone standing near to a flare is immune to being marked while it's still burning. 

We think this extra utility makes flares an even more useful part of Pathfinder's kit and will make the Flyers feel a tad less omniscient. To mitigate this new ability, remember that Dilophosaurus spit can extinguish flares!

[h3][b]FIRST STEP TOWARDS TEAM SORTING[/b][/h3]

PCE game servers now log basic performance data of players from match to match in the background. This is an initial step towards implementing more advanced team sorting. 

Being rank 150 doesn't [i]guarantee [/i]a player is an elite pro gamer, but it can be demoralizing when all of the Evolved people are on one team. We're going to gather stats from matches with this patch to see how best to engineer our new sorting algorithm. Once ready, the game will sort players according to various criteria when a new match starts to try and have the fairest distribution.

[h3][b]SMOOTHING THINGS OUT[/b][/h3]

A lot of what we're doing lately is getting rid of some of the rough edges and awkwardness with some of the game's mechanics. One of our focuses has been making weapons feel better, smoothing out issues with various timers that prevent you from doing certain actions. For a complete list of all the fixes and improvements in today's patch, see below...


[h2][b]FULL CHANGELOG, Patch 2.9.21[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Added healing over time for dino melee kills, takes 2 seconds
[*] Taking damage doesn't entirely cancel the healing, but reduces amount of health to be restored
[*] Tyrants healing from eating humans is now staggered, triggering 4 times over the course of the animation and checking if the human is still in the mouth.

[*] Made it so both tyrants get the full health when snatching humans from one another

[*] fixed no charge-up indicator for bracing as a Tyrant
[*] implemented custom animations for Tyrants when bracing
[*] using the Acro stomp attack now forces you to exit bracing
[*] tyrants are now forced out of sprinting when initiating brace, and vice versa
[*] fixed Tyrant brace not stopping when out of stamina (below minimum amount required to brace)
[*] fixed tyrant brace not being enabled by holding down the "crouch" button 
(can use either crouch or special movement key)

[*] Carnotaurus now has reduced attack damage after roaring:
 - headbutt damage reduced from 85 to 63 while roared
- secondary reduced from 50 to 40 while roared

[*] pathfinder flares now remove the marked status from humans if they are within a certain radius
[*] if a human is close enough to pathfinder flares, they are immune to being marked by Flyers

[*] Can now swap weapons while firing more smoothly
[*] Cancelling out of reloading / firing a weapon is now easier
[*] Slightly better accuracy for poison dart rifle + one more round in the magazine
[*] Flamethrower should now have an easier time igniting pools on sloped terrain
[*] Started fixing certain weapon reload animations getting cut off

[*] fixed out of breath sounds for humans not playing in multiplayer
[*] fixed SMG sound glitching when holding fire button during reloading
[*] fixed incorrect rotation for the left SMG muzzle flash (shell casings galore!)
[*] updated rumble effects and sound notifies for several weapons

[*] updated TDM scoreboard sorting, is now: max(kills, assists) - deaths
[*] fixed new dinosaur crosshair turning red when looking at already dead humans
[*] fixed multiple-choice death hints changing super fast while waiting to respawn
[*] fixed a rounding issue with the scoreboard that could produce really long score numbers
[*] fixed main menu Evolve button not being pressable sometimes
[*] fixed a server crash related to animation glitching
[*] added end of round stat printouts viewable in server .Log files
[/list]
[h3][b]It's Getting Hot In Here..[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/8c6883a6a90ca7a8a496f37719aba756f1df1095.jpg[/img]

We're currently building towards the release of our PlayStation beta this month, as well as the annual Meltdown event on Steam. 

The next update (Summer Warmup) will release at the end of June and bring some initial preparations for the massive 3.0 overhaul. As our focus is more on the PS4 side currently, we'll have a smaller set of new items debuting here. The epic Meltdown motherlode will be heating things up later this summer. 

It's going to be a crazy couple of months, and we're looking forward to bringing you lots of new features, maps, and more soon!
[i][b]
Thanks for playing![/b][/i]
-The Primal Carnage Team

notes.title: New merch / Bruiser Bash / Patch 2.9.20
notes.content:
A new patch is now available for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam!
We have updates to the official merch shop, another retro store rotation and several fixes / tweaks...

[h2][b]Game Changes[/b][/h2]

We're mainly focusing on minor tweaks and quality of life fixes currently while preparing to launch the PlayStation beta. Today's patch includes several of these changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/2667debaef806a0c92a180aa0b5aef8e5d037a81.jpg[/img]
Dinosaurs now have a new more "Primal" feeling crosshair, which turns blood red when hovered over an enemy (those who prefer a minimal look can swap to a simple dot in the gameplay settings). This change is particularly helpful for Tyrants, whose giant heads can obscure the targets they are trying to eat.

The mercenaries can now trigger inspection animations for several weapons by pressing Reload when they have a full clip. We'll be expanding this to *all* weapons in a future patch. 

Camera animations have started to be updated, with adjustments to sniper rifles and the netgun motions. Tyrant footsteps now have more noticeable screenshake that persists across a greater distance, with a longer and more pronounced camera wobble which hopefully makes them less "stealthy."

However, our primary focus on PC has been investigating some of the more stubborn old bugs. One of the more devious issues was projectiles "losing their owner" on death, leading to human teammates catching fire or exploding if someone was autobalanced or died at the worst moment. 

This has now been resolved, and we're looking into squashing other annoying issues with partial fixes already. If possible, please report any serious bugs you encounter on the [url=https://discord.com/channels/135491486983651328/347071867045281792]Bug-Reporting[/url] channel of the official discord and include your latest .log file (found in the Logs folder of your PCE game install).


[h2][b]NEW MERCH![/b][/h2]

The [url=https://store.primalcarnage.com/]official merchandise store[/url] now features a new batch of items, ranging from action-packed posters to truly Jurassic-sized mouse mats! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/b2583b4a589d1669b1e02105d03d88f22db87a88.jpg[/img]

There are brand new dark mugs such as the ominous Novaraptor Stasis, more T-shirt variants, and some lovely stickers to show your dino appreciation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/421c76c2bef6a761ddfd6a365b5b572ea6efa44d.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.primalcarnage.com/]Click [b]HERE[/b] to visit the merchandise store[/url], and look forward to even more merch being added soon!

notes.title: Version 2.9.15 Now Available
notes.content:
An update for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] is now available on Steam!
Check out the highlights below, or scroll down for the full changelog...

[h2][b]Update Highlights[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Visual Tweak: 
Holstered Weapons[/b][/h3]

A new visual feature we've added is being able to see[b] holstered weapons[/b] on human characters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qoi5jGd.gif[/img]

For example: if a scientist is using her tranq pistol but is also carrying an assault cannon, you can see the cannon attached to her back while it's not in use. Sidearms are a bit harder to see, but both those and primary weapons are displayed on the character's body.

Aside from just being cool, we think this should be helpful in general to sharp-eyed dinosaurs. You now have a chance to see what you're going up against instead of being completely surprised now when they pull out a weapon.

[h3][b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/h3]

One community suggestion we decided to explore for this patch has to do with Tyrants. As of today, they are now[i] body snatchers[/i]. If a raptor is pouncing a human, or a Pteranodon has someone in their claws, a Tyrant can bite and hijack that human for themselves to eat. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h3YI8Oe.gif[/img]

In fairness to raptors and Pteras, they receive kill credit for the human that was stolen from them. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4dGI3V7.gif[/img]

An interesting side effect of this change is that Tyrants can now feed humans to each other if they're fast enough (both of them receive health)....

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nRnM4AR.gif[/img]

Tupa has received a rework to how its impact momentum is actually calculated, leading to a big reduction in vertical knockback when ramming into humans with its head. The distance is about the same, but we think the amount of damage the human feels is a bit more fair now.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4FGicUo.gif[/img]

Elsewhere, we have continued to address bugs and annoyances such as raptors pouncing people while netted, or it being difficult to ignite acid with the flaregun. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/boQA1wG.gif[/img]

A lot of focus has been on improving controller support as well, with menu sizes and navigation being improved in several key areas. This should make things better both for regular gamepad users and those on Steam Deck.


[h2][b]In-store: Retro Rotations[/b][/h2]

Easter is now hopping aside to make way for a roaring retro rampage of classic skins, taunts, mutations and more over the next several weeks! 

[previewyoutube=-7v_Lyc2xvo;full][/previewyoutube]

Starting with a [i][b]Tyrant Takeover[/b][/i], there are ~100 Acro / Rex / Spino items back today with epic discounts! Check back each week as we shine a spotlight on other classic item collections going forward...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/9708bd603d9f0befa723328e6522ec956ea4640f.jpg[/img]

You can quickly browse all of the returning items on our [url=https://trello.com/b/FXE3SzJo/special-event-items][b]Special Trello Board[/b][/url], and preview them in-game.


[h2][b]Version 2.9.15 - Full Changelog[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]Modified the Tupa's air ram momentum, now does much less vertical knockback when headbutting

[*]Added the ability for tyrants to snatch humans away from pouncing raptors or grabbing pteras
[*]Tyrants that snatch a human from another dinosaur get health but the other dino gets kill credit
[*]Tyrants can now play "pass the human" with eachother

[*]Humans now show un-equipped weapons holstered on their body

[*]Ignition radius for Cryo acid pools when hit by the flaregun is now larger
[*]Increased the amount of ammunition dual pistols receive from ammo pickups 
[*]Adjusted human character collision so it's easier to hit teammates with the tranq pistol
[*]Controller rumble adjustments for various heavy sniper, bow, dual pistol, melee and SMG actions

[*]Fixed being able to melee spam with the burst rifle
[*]Fixed being able to reload/shoot/throw/swap weapons when taunting
[*]Fixed sometimes being unable to take off again after using Tupa's divebomb attack
[*]Fixed raptor pounce/mauling not stopping when the raptor gets netted mid-pounce
[*]Fixed the letter V mysteriously making you sprint without being actually bound to sprint

[*]Enlargered the Options menus so that they fill the window now
[*]Added sorting button to inventory, swaps between original order and reverse order
[*]Reversed inventory sorting by default to place mutations and skins at the top for dinosaurs
[*]Added hover animation when rolling across the social buttons on main menu

[*]Gamepad: made it easier to select the Redeem Key option in-store
[*]Gamepad: added shortcut for opening the News feed on main menu

notes.title: Easter 2023 Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Happy Easter![/b][/h2]

Grab your Greneggs, a new update for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] is now available!

This update includes a seasonal Easter Event along with several fixes and improvements, plus adjustments to several weapons and dinosaurs. Read on for all the details...

[h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/05d9340b6a6aa13e308368d145173125fc4ad7ec.png[/img]

Tupandactylus has received some tweaks to make it less of a headache to deal with. Namely, the air ram "headbutt" attack is now less damaging and there's not quite as much knockback from it. To offset this, both Tupa and Ptera now have the same health (350).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/dee68733939b9f300dcd441e94a475a965b7a5ae.png[/img]

The flaregun has seen a radical reworking, its shots now have a small amount of heat-seeking when they fly close to a target. Coupled with this, flaregun shots that land on the ground can now ignite enemies that walk over them. Finally, it has a faster reload speed, but much less ammo than previously, with the projectiles flying slower through the air.

Humans in general should now be a bit more effective in combat. Most guns outside of sniper rifles / special weapons (flamethrower, netgun etc.) now have better mid-range damage output. From the humble MK Pistol, to the speedy Spaz-12, most guns now pack more of a wallop without needing to be in a dinosaur's face. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/97580ca8f97f87149ad0d49e9b0467b488950716.gif[/img]

There are a number of other changes as well, such as more damaging Cryo acid pools and tweaks to the stungun, which you can see in the full notes further down. We're interested to see how these changes play out, as it seemed the mercenary team were still at a disadvantage oftentimes in recent months. 

[h2][b]Easter Event[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/d3edae9589b537bb9efca4b534b1eea18aa488d0.jpg[/img]

We're celebrating Easter with a fresh batch of new looks in-game today, focused on our feathered fiends! From glorious (and gigantic) Oviraptor mutations, to fluffy Novas and Spitters, there's a tonne of cracking new cosmetics...

[previewyoutube=bSQyWT-E99o;full][/previewyoutube]

Grab the 2023 Easter Gift to award up to 24 other players with special Easter items! It includes a new Rex mutation, tracking devices for all dinos, new human outfits and a whole flock of Ovi skins! This bumper box contains 33 different items total, with splashy new looks galore such as the epic Gold Slash Spino...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/071789e8c68803f84a40879740d2c311d0763b73.png[/img]

And don't forget - over 50 classic items are returning today as well!

Looking outside of the store, there are a handful of new free drop skins and sprays added to the game. These aren't time-limited and will be sticking around after the Easter Event concludes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/89e7eff5e2e66ea2e868fd44fd34479a63304f6d.jpg[/img]

As always, you can check out all of the latest items added to the game on our [url=https://trello.com/b/FXE3SzJo/special-event-items][b]Special Event Trello[/b][/url] board!

[h2][b]Looking Ahead to 3.0[/b][/h2]

There may be a stretch without content updates for a while as we finalize the revised PlayStation version of Primal Carnage going forward. We're in the final stages of getting our closed console beta approved (once it stops crashing, we'll be accepting testers). 

The next big release on PC will be version 3.0, which will bring a lot of the added polish and enhancements being made for the revised PS4 edition to the Steam side. These include more gameplay improvements, large-scale map reworks, expanded lore and backstory, refined UI and HUD with more customizability, and maybe even some new voice acting. 

We're unsure when this update will release, but it will most likely be after the PS4 relaunch. We look forward to sharing more about all this in the coming months, and hope you'll like the new overhauls once they're in your hands! Until then, here is the changelog for Easter...

[h2][b]Changelog, Version 2.9.14[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased effective damage of most weapons at their mid-range point
(affected guns include all shotguns, AR, M4, burst rifle, SMGs, Colts,  MK, Deagle)

[*] Tightened spread pattern on all shotguns
[*] Heavy melee attacks have been sped up for most guns
[*] Added more controller rumble events to first person animations such as reloading
[*] Increased base rumble intensity of firing weapons

[*] Increased stungun max charge damage from 180 to 200
[*] Stungun minimum stunned duration reduced from 1 sec to 0.75 seconds
[*] Reduced self-damage from stungun auto-discharge when held too long

[*] Minor reduction to SMG damage distance
[*] Fixed an issue with dual pistols reloading audio

[*] Faster damage tick interval for Cryo acid pools
[*] Increased acid pool tick damage from 25 to 30

[*] Flaregun projectiles now have a small amount of "heat seeking" if they fly close to a target
[*] Flaregun shots that land on the ground can now ignite enemies
[*] Reduced flaregun instant hit damage from 90 to 65
[*] Flaregun critical hits now do 1.5x damage instead of triple damage
[*] Reduced how much fire damage flaregun shots do over time
[*] Added more recoil and spread to the flaregun
[*] Reduced flaregun projectile's speed
[*] Reduced flaregun ammo pickup amount 
[*] Flaregun now reloads much faster

[*] Moderate reduction to Tupa headbutt knockback
[*] Reduced maximum Tupa headbutt damage from 70 to 60
[*] Increased health of Ptera from 320 to 350

[*] Increased detection check radius for Tupa headbutt
[*] Reduced tupa knockback, reduced minimum charge damage

[*] Reduced minimum flight time to explode for AR grenades
[*] Possible fix for assault rifle grenades bouncing too much

[*] Fixed some instances where keyboard prompts were still shown when using a gamepad
[*] Can now swap between tabs in the store using L1 and R1 buttons on controller
[*] Player ID card screen is now closeable the same way as all other menus on controller 
[*] Can now use Triangle/Y for changing avatars in main menu with controller
[*] Fixed controllers getting stuck when navigating certain menus

[*] Store price tags now use a larger font
[*] Item-names/descriptions in store are now larger when hovered
[*] Updated the Deluxe DLC store link to point directly to the bundle page on Steam
[*] Merch Store link now goes to the main homepage of the shop instead of Accessories

[*] Added new Easter cosmetic content
[*] Character texture memory optimizations
[*] Updated eye masking for Glory Cryo skin

[*] Fixed garbled text on a few death screen hints

[*] Network priority adjustments that may improve loadout synchronization
[/list]

notes.title: Green Menaces, Deluxe Edition and Steam Deck
notes.content:
[b]Happy St. Patrick's Day![/b]

A new update for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] is now available. Alongside today's patch, we have a fresh rotation of new looks in-store, a special Deluxe Edition DLC bundle, plus official support for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamdeck][b]Steam Deck![/b][/url]

[h2][b]NEW Deluxe Edition[/b][/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30725/Primal_Carnage_Extinction__Deluxe_Edition][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/4251099690bd327d8fccefcfd9d315b8a139e31f.jpg[/img][/url]

Today we're launching a[b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30725/Primal_Carnage_Extinction__Deluxe_Edition]Deluxe Edition[/url] [/b] bundle for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam, which features a generous assortment of classic items!

We have two cosmetic DLC packs as part of the Deluxe Edition bundle - the [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327501/Primal_Carnage_Extinction__Mercenary_Megapack_DLC/]Mercenary Megapack[/url] [/i]and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327500/Primal_Carnage_Extinction__Prehistoric_Legacy_DLC/]Prehistoric Legacy Collection[/url][/i]. In total, owning both of these grants you over 300 items, ranging from regular skins for humans and dinosaurs to model mutations and taunts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/e1edea69a3ab568a46098996336750777a0d701e.jpg[/img]

Some of these items have previously only been available during special time-limited events such as the Summer Scavenger Hunt, but now you can acquire them [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30725/Primal_Carnage_Extinction__Deluxe_Edition]as part of the Deluxe Edition bundle[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/9aed4e23a17a360deee28f61e9462ac6cb96489b.jpg[/img]

With even the official soundtrack included in the bundle, we think this is a great value starter pack for new players! If you [i]already [/i]own PCE, you can choose to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30725/Primal_Carnage_Extinction__Deluxe_Edition/][b]upgrade to Deluxe[/b][/url] with a discount. And for those only interested in[i] one[/i] of the item collections, you can also choose to buy each DLC pack [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/321360/Primal_Carnage_Extinction/][i]separately[/i][/url].

Importantly, by purchasing the complete Deluxe Edition you will be supporting future development! 
We're committed to providing more updates and new content for the game (Version 3.0 is on the way!), but your help is invaluable in keeping us going. 

Players who own both the Prehistoric Legacy Collection [i]and[/i] Mercenary Megapack DLCs will receive a special golden nameplate in-game that is visible to other players, as a sign of their supporter status.

[h2][b]Steam Deck[/b][/h2]

We're rolling out official support for Steam Deck this update. We'd received quite a few requests for this, and since we love the Deck we were happy to oblige! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/3db80f0dd279fefa5115be34d4c8753faafdd37c.jpg[/img]

It might be a while before Valve reviews our compatibility status again, so for now we may not show in the "Great on Deck" section. But fear not, with today's update installed you should be able to boot the game up with no problems on Steam Deck. You can now play PCE multiplayer wherever you go, so long as there's good internet access (or do some solo Survival if the wi-fi is out). 

If you're lucky enough to own one, please let us know how your experience on Steam Deck goes! We've fine-tuned the graphics options on first boot so that you should have rock solid performance, but if you encounter issues we'll endeavour to investigate. 

[h2][b]St. Patrick's Event[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=KH-ztUOONww;full][/previewyoutube]

Spring is almost upon us and this St. Patrick's Day we're celebrating again with a gaggle of green cosmetics. Two new sets of bold dinosaur skins headline this store rotation, the Green Menace packs! Between them there's 14 voracious veridian creatures ready to be set free...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/39f2fcb61beae74c7150e4cbcacb7b7aa4265e47.png[/img]

Marching into the store are several new mutations as well, ranging from the snarling Sarcophagus Acro to the terrifying Thanatos Carno, ready to give you a snap. Not to mention, there's two weird and wonderful Pachycephalosaurus variants - Annectens and Kapros!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/c1bbc43cdf3c9e727122617c69c47953516e972d.gif[/img]

Outside of the store, there are a handful of new free drops being added to the game. Why not get into the spirit with a Lucky Fedora, or bling out your Acro with the Goldrush skin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/5b9784791e7d00e60e4b308bd4718e66b406d91e.jpg[/img]

As always, you can check out all of the latest items added to the game on our [url=https://trello.com/b/FXE3SzJo/special-event-items][b]Special Event Trello[/b][/url] board!

[list]
[*] Updated to a newer version of Steamworks for better compatibility
[*] Reduced size of the game's .EXE file, may improve performance
[*] Fixed an issue with Ptera grabbing people when hovering
[*] Added new St. Patricks Event cosmetic content
[*] Smoothed out Commando's head to be less polygonal
[*] Another fix for the "Not So Fast" achievement not triggering correctly

[*] Added new Steam Deck default system settings for smooth performance on handheld, (automatically applied when playing on Deck)

notes.title: Special Valentines Event
notes.content:
A new update is available for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam!
We hope you'll just [i]love[/i] what we have for you this Valentine's Day...

[h2][b]February Update Highlights[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3]

We're continuing to fine tune things for Flyers after the addition of manual flight modes last update. They now have better blending between hovering and regular flight, and several bugs / exploits relating to changing flight mode have been fixed. There's some additional polish planned for Flyers in future, but things should be a lot more stable now.

Elsewhere, several issues with achievement and challenge tracking have been resolved. So you won't get an achievement for blocking bullets with your dome skull as a human now, and tranquilizer-related tasks should complete properly.

Additional minor fixes are listed in the changelog further down, but the bulk of today's update is our...

[h2][b]SPECIAL VALENTINES EVENT[/b][/h2]

[b]Love is in the air,[/b] we're celebrating [i]Valentine's Day[/i] by rotating in a parade of colourful (particularly pink) new looks for you to enjoy!

[previewyoutube=H3tK8Ef1M8A;full][/previewyoutube]

Having said that... they're not all as loud as Mister Pink! We also have some slightly more reserved styles arriving today, such as the Rugged Rex and Risen Novaraptor...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/55e3dd8bd82e485c45ab89770de272bd4d9cd2e6.jpg[/img]

Although we simply couldn't say no to an Anomalocaris Hat- this weirdly adorable (if slightly creepy) new head warmer is now available in-store...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/f6dc3992076118ae75a8766ad3b0079d656f4cbe.png[/img]

In addition to the new looks, there are two fresh taunts added today! 
Check out the Spinosaurus Display Taunt and Ceratosaurus Defensive Roar...

And of course all of the legacy Valentines items are back at a discount for the duration of the event. Share the love with a classic Valentines Gift, showering up to 24 other people on a server with items! 


[h3][b]New FREE Drops![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/3887947039c341f7eec0582f9e51fe4ee65f8a35.jpg[/img]

A collection of new drops are activated today, from the blinding Pink Paws Burst Rifle to the terrifying new Torvus Cerato mutation. As well as new looks, we have a selection of fresh sprays and avatars dropping as well, such as the totes adorbs Raptor Heart:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/d6a669e3c556310533a0e3bb012a8bd891343064.png[/img]

You can view all of the latest special event items on [url=https://trello.com/b/FXE3SzJo/special-event-items][b]our Trello board![/b][/url]

[h3][b]Paint Mixers Availability[/b][/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/d709965b0228baeae527c5bd677ff7038931a8ba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/cb82602cd5966dbe8615090ab2e813656a938c16.png[/img][/url]
We've expanded the ways you can obtain Paint Mixer Tools! These are the single-use items required to save your custom look when using the dinosaur colourizer. They're still available on the in-game store, but are now [i]tradable[/i] and can be obtained as [b]free drops[/b].

With this change, you now have the chance to acquire Paint Mixer Tools during regular gameplay, or by levelling up, and by completing challenges. Just as a reminder, any multi-pack of paint you buy in-store comes with a Paint Mixer Tool included as well.

[h3][b]Until Next Time![/b][/h3]

We'll be continuing to make more minor changes and fixes throughout spring while we prepare to relaunch Primal on PlayStation. Thankyou for your patience.


[h1][b]FULL CHANGELOG[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]VERSION 2.9.12[/b][/h3]

[list]

[*] Reduced intensity of wing flaps when entering hover mode as Flyers

[/list]

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
[i]And so it begins... again...[/i]

2023 sees the Primal Carnage franchise starting its second decade, and we'll be continuing to support PCE on PC with more updates throughout. Today we have a small one to kick the year off, with a few fixes and mechanic tweaks alongside the January store rotation...

[h3][b]Feature Update:[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]Manual Flight Modes[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/344edd8c06d18853c1dee3c4a2ef4ebb1c45444a.jpg[/img]

Pteranodon and Tupandactylus can now swap between regular flight or hover flight by tapping Alt. When regular flight mode is active, Flyers will now continue gliding forwards if there is no input - instead of automatically hovering on the spot the way they did previously. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FTY2MR5.gif[/img]

Swapping to hover mode while flying at high speed acts as an air brake. When in hover mode, you can rapidly ascend with the "jump" button or descend on the spot in freefall using the "crouch" button. Continue holding crouch to gain speed while descending. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/278cb5902b19494834148396a3a80b43bf7e8d86.png[/img]
Hovering around allows for precise movements when trying to land on a specific spot, unlike regular flight. An indicator for the active flight mode is shown in the bottom right of the HUD when flying now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/c73f91cb9856dc7ac3c65748d0d33be295dca4bd.png[/img]

[h3][b]Special Movement Key[/b][/h3]

The flyer changes are part of a broader adjustment- the addition of a customizable Special Movement key for dinosaurs. Outside of the Flyers, other classes which use this currently are the Pachy for its slide ability, and Tyrants use it to brace. These actions are still doable by crouching, but you now have the option of using the rebindable Special Movement key as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/ce870561fd84331abf0974014980eac211e6fdb7.gif[/img]

We may look to include some additional utility for other dinosaurs in future now that there's a dedicated button for it. Watch this space.


[h3][b]Feature Update:[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]Contextual Respawn Hints[/b][/h2]

The tutorial hints system has been expanded with the addition of tips that display while you are waiting to respawn. These "death hints" are contextual in that they pertain to the method in which you died. So depending on which weapon, class, or attack killed you, the game will try to display an appropriate hint. 

We'll expand on these and continue to add more types of tutorialization in future, to help expose the many interesting quirks of Primal's gameplay. Like all the existing hints, they can be toggled On / Off in the game's options menu. 


[h2][b]New Year, New Looks[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=ueD6DW3C1n8;full][/previewyoutube]

Our seasonal event may have come to a close but winter is still clinging on, with some cold blooded beasties stomping into the store today. We have a brand new set of mutations and beautiful boreal skins such as the Frozen Wake Tupa and magnificent Icefall Feathered Spinosaurus...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/87cd2c4c997d706d7c8a0feb046060ea423db6cd.jpg[/img]

Stay both warm AND stylish with suits for all mercenaries! Not to be outdone by Agent Stone, a wardrobe of four tailored tuxedos for each human is now available. So, meet Agent Angus, Agent Crane, Agent Hart, and Agent Tyler bundles along with a retroactive pack containing several agent trapper skins...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/31ccc52e1bc7b79daa13047145a7da8e6d838fbc.jpg[/img]

Since the resident medical staff has no more need for it, our Commando can now don the Field Medic's outfit, perfect for the heavy weapons guy with the healing hands. And when it comes to pre-loved clothes, you can't go wrong with the Wilderness Commando outfit which has some rather charming slashes taken out of it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/8fcd4dc37c3002c7497332b4e43707da152de71f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Free Drops[/b][/h3]

Several new items have been added to the drop pool, obtainable by just playing the game, or completing challenges / crafting. White as the driven snow, the Winter Sneaking Suit is a legendary Scientist skin variant with piercing blue eyes. There is also a combo option cigar and shades for the Trapper, plus a couple of new weapon skins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/7dd3dde7b7e3ad9b9c8131272b2b0cab11bb83a0.jpg[/img]

On the dinosaur side, the bold Ribbon Eel Acro is a legendary new look. And two striking new Bruiser mutations charge into the game: Ranaepedes Cerato & Torosus Carno...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/d702bce1504ceb34286b76d1c109a1a6bc992ad0.jpg[/img]

Finally, a couple of fun sprays / avatars have been added to the game...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/6d341571bcbaaae106065ccd00fc5fc80c9c1591.png[/img]

You can get a closer look at all of the items in the latest update on our [url=https://trello.com/b/FXE3SzJo/special-event-items][b]Special Trello Board[/b][/url], or preview them directly in-game.


[h2][b]Version 2.9.11 Changelog[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] New manual flight mode option for Flyers, toggle hover mode with Alt key
[*] When in hover mode, hold crouch to rapidly descend on the spot
[*] Added customizable Special Movement key for Tyrant bracing, Pachy slide, flight modes

[*] Expanded clip size and reserve ammo of tranquilizer pistol
[*] Faster reload speed for tranquilizer pistol

[*] Added contextual "death hints" that display on the respawn screen 
[*] Reverted the snowy main menu and basic testing maps to normal
[*] Fixed the Acro plush being backwards when worn by Scientist
[*] Fixed a missing item description
[/list]

[h2][b]Happy New Year![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/228c1bf5b48a9ee0a4d5c4cdbcfd5af69413b8dc.jpg[/img]

After all this time, we're still here. 

We have a busy year ahead of us, and hope you'll enjoy what we have in the works behind the scenes. More minor updates are coming throughout spring as we work on refreshing the PS4 side of Primal.
Valentines, St. Patricks and Easter will be here soon, and there's some big overhauls planned in future!

Thanks for playing!
[i]-The Primal Carnage Team[/i]


[url=discord.gg/primalcarnage][b]For all things Primal Carnage, get involved on the Official Discord...[/b][/url]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/primalcarnage][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/8d7dd8cd87c4f85f27be94c269175aae5bd5e157.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/f411645de40f2990c55cded1098fbdab18430dc3.png[/img]

[i][b]Happy holidays![/b][/i]
We've got a new update for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] on Steam!

There's plenty of presents this year, with over 150 new winter themed items being added to the game! Not only that, but we've been doing some deep engine code work to improve the feel of PCE in general. 

Read on for the highlights, and see the full changelog further down...
(thanks to community artist BadPlague for the artwork!)


[h2][b]CORE GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/b][/h2]

This winter we're continuing to improve and rework some of the fundamental systems in the game, to create better moment to moment gameplay. Chief among these is how characters collide with the world. We've put a big focus on trying to avoid players becoming stuck or getting caught on objects, so now you should smoothly slide off in most cases instead. 

With the tweaks we've made, movement in general feels much more fluid as you can step over many more smaller obstacles. There may be a couple of areas you can get to which you shouldn't, and we'll fix those in time, but we're really happy with the results so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/fce7a7659272bf50e92819cccf6c9d2b8ca11548.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we reworked character rotation to mitigate dinosaurs turning the wrong way when making long turns. This is a big help for Tyrants and Bruisers in particular,  it being way less likely for them to suddenly jerk in the wrong direction now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/23dbe4a5285ac0146a2db6c9b6508af177b126b2.jpg[/img]

We are exploring future updates to melee hit detection, but have made a small tweak this update which should make melee a bit more reliable. Detection traces for impacts now fire off much more frequently, hopefully making it harder for your attack to miss.


[h2][b]WINTER STORE EVENT[/b][/h2]

From adorable plush backpacks, to feather galore, and some seriously cool new mutations... there are dozens of new featured items in-store this winter!

[previewyoutube=JOG2kpSJJjw;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside a new cold-hearted collection of Royal Acros, the Novaraptor joins the monarchy this month with the first trifecta of Royal Nova skins! Featuring a unique partially feathered model and distinctly regal feather arrangements, they are quite a sight...

Everyone's looking to keep warm this winter, and there's an avalanche of feather coated fiends arriving today, such as those in the Northern Novaraptor Bundle. Humans have to watch out for the cold too, though! What better way to keep yourself cozy than wearing the corpse of your enemies? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/49acaae44661796f6047b1f8a9455115484cc753.png[/img]

There's a wolfskin pelt, Compy caps, and even stuffed animal packs with demon glowing eyes- [b][i]festive![/i][/b] We've also got a couple of crazy human taunts... I mean, why not go wild with the dancing scientist?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e0YPVc1.gif[/img]

And get a lucky shot with Trapper's net pitcher taunt to ensnare a dinosaur if they're close enough!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/47c13899d422657944b75edd873e04deef7c1939.gif[/img]

There's even a crowbar now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/8008b27a15add1ea0ee3773b02d9d4b9e95ddaff.gif[/img]

And of course all of the legacy winter items are back at a discount for the duration of the winter event. Pick up a gift and spread festive cheer across the server, showering people with seasonal items! Don't forget you can grab three classic gifts for the price of one with the Gift Bag bundle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/ddf4ab8acd759d1fe8b2781985b0ee5fb4efc2b1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New FREE Drops![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/d35da7b165b38e368da182c172dc1d30ec6c2d34.jpg[/img]

Santa Claws returns, raining down baubles from his pterosaur powered sleigh! Most of them are highly dangerous assault weapons, so just as well this island is solely inhabited by mercenaries...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/a5a9f42925cd9c2ff54e6d4e4eba8e17b80d0fe3.jpg[/img]

Classic winter drops have also been reactivated and we're running a DOUBLE DROP event until January, where you can obtain twice the usual weekly limit of random item drops during winter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/24bcff9cff772748bd57bc5e5a41655862d87160.jpg[/img]

And remember, you can view all of this year's new winter items on [url=https://trello.com/b/FXE3SzJo/special-event-items]our Special Event Trello page![/url]


[h1][b]FULL CHANGELOG[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]VERSION 2.9.10[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/ef5f004219ea05314bec24005cf2b2df53e0da79.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Major rework of character collision with the environment, greatly reducing stuck spots for dinosaurs and making movement in general much more fluid. 

[*] Overhaul of character rotation - is now less likely for dinosaurs to suddenly turn the wrong way.

[*] Melee trace checks now occur much more frequently, which should help with reliability.

[*] Updated default Tyrant limits for TDM (minimum players required to spawn increased from 10 to 12)

[*] Reduced Carnotaurus health regen from charge while roared to be the same as its secondary attack 
[*] Increased air ram momentum multiplier for Tupa from 0.8x to 1.0x
[*] Carno/Cera/Pachy charge kills now send dead human ragdolls flying in more natural ways

[*] Machete and other heavy melee attacks now go through dinosaur armour
[*] Updated assault cannon reload timing to feel better, with no awkward delay after firing
[*] Added 3rd person equip animations for the AR, M4, BR, Shotgun and Sniper Rifle
[*] All other weapons now have at least a placeholder anim (throw) in 3rd person when swapping

[*] Compound Bow updates:

[list]
[*] Swapping arrows is now possible while sprinting
[*] When your last arrow is fired, the bow now auto-swaps to the alternate arrow type
[*] Can now swap arrow types when drawing the bow back (causes current arrow to fire)
[/list]
[*] Specified unique movement sounds for all other Robo dinosaur skins
[*] Added unique movement sounds when wearing Tyrant chains
[*] Adjusted the kill assist sound to be less intrusive
[*] Reduced volume of "Rextended" main menu theme
 
[*] Another fix for camera shaking endlessly on Pyro death
[*] Fixed incorrect status effect icon duration for dinosaurs hit by tracking arrows
[*] Fixed spamming spacebar in scoreboard closing the game
[*] Fixed some items showing as "skinname skinname" in store previewer
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when in the customization screen
[*] Added class family categories to filter by when using the Browse tab in-store
[*] Swapped out main menu for the winter version
[*] Various post process effect optimizations
[*] Updated the credits
[/list]

[h3][b]STEAM WINTER SALE![/b][/h3]

Give the gift of Carnage this winter! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/321360

Primal Carnage: Extinction, the PCE 4-pack bundle and even the original soundtrack are discounted during the Steam Winter Sale, so it's a great time to jump into all the carnage!


[h3][b]SEE YOU NEXT YEAR[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/41225fe64c0238b2d8b9660875c2db83f98947ab.jpg[/img]

We're back in 2023 with more gameplay overhauls as the revised PlayStation version enters beta.
Why not [url=discord.gg/primalcarnage][b]join us on Discord [/b][/url]to discuss everything Primal Carnage?


[h3]Thankyou all for playing, and have a great holiday! [/h3]
[i]-The Primal Carnage Team [/i]

notes.title: December Patch 2.9.9
notes.content:
A new update for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] is now live!

The December Patch brings some new gameplay features to enhance certain weapons and play-styles, along with more quality of life improvements and balance adjustments. 

While our chief programmers are busy fixing platform-specific errors on the PlayStation side, the rest of us have had bonus time to polish and improve various aspects of the game, with some interesting results!

Not to mention, today also marks the start of our winter festivities!
Read on for some jolly good changes...


[h2][b]Playing Medic[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Updates to the Scientist Class[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/da97809b7cc0387f3d71f64c789e51023690c95a.jpg[/img]

Since a few players were lamenting the loss of their medkits this year, we're happy to announce that the Scientist class has some new utilities to allow her to be played as a healer!

You can now use the Tranquilizer Pistol to heal allies and give them a small amount of armour. This is one occasion where shooting your friends is a good idea! Allies can withstand more damage with this buff applied and it allows the Scientist to help their buddies from afar. Being hit by a dino shortens the buff duration, so watch your distance.

[i]But that's not all! [/i]
Have you ever felt the need? The need for speed? 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/2d60a9046f0d4819f8b424124cfa4aaf875bc3ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/1854725abc906a53143250f16e41e005488e5b2c.png[/img][/url]

Everyone's favourite energy drink is breaking free of Survival mode. Yes, [b]SPEEDGREED[/b] is now a throwable item for the Scientist! She picked up a multi-pack from somewhere and can now throw down a set of cold ones to revive herself or her friends (limit one drink per person). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/b9ce32b5c7517c830ffb4be362b1639d87040039.gif[/img]

The buff applies a movement speed boost to anyone who picks it up, lasting 15 seconds. This can be particularly helpful when getting to the chopper!

[h3]New Arrow Type:[/h3]
[h2][b]TRACKING ARROWS[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/82a1acc16fff02906b52f9d48d0e76eaa6c2b46f.gif[/img]

A new alternate special arrow type is now available for the compound bow. If you have the bow equipped, use the [b]Special Ammo slot[/b]  in Customization to choose what kind of special arrows you want to use... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/da30bff1ff4b50ae95cb9a85929ec05716ca1276.jpg[/img]

Swapping out the default Explosive Arrows for Tracker Arrows lets you fire a special variant that [b]highlights enemies for your team[/b] if you land a hit. This can be useful in tracking down particularly annoying targets. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/16c2b28f5371888b87237c0a493430f3c9d57a69.gif[/img]

We have additional functionality planned for the tracking arrows further down the track, and yet more arrow types planned in future. It's been a lot of fun testing these updates the past few weeks, and we're excited to see how the changes will play out in live :)

[h2][b]Store Updates[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]CHRISTMAS COMES EARLY![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/0848071baab5a50f8a021d645eb2fcfb4d34fb76.png[/img]

We're bringing back all of the legacy holiday content starting[b] TODAY[/b] in-store! That's nearly 8 years of returning classics, ranging from festive outfits to merry mutations. An avalanche of awesome!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tLpT1M6.gif[/img]

Oh and of course, they're all on sale! Grab great festive deals from now until early next year.
And in the spirit of giving, winter free drop items are now live, along with [i][b]DOUBLE DROPS[/b][/i]!

[h3][b]IN-GAME STORE OVERHAUL, PART ONE[/b][/h3]

This update marks the start of a larger overhaul to the Extinction Store, with our end goal to make it a much more user friendly experience...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fk6A2YF.gif[/img]

So, you can now preview (almost) all items available in the store! This includes multi-item packs, so you can browse through every single cosmetic contained within a bundle. 

We also remembered that weapons haven't had a proper preview.. uh.. ever... so they can now be checked out as well, including weapon bundles such as the Arsenal Appearance Packs. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SOrjner.gif[/img]

Multi-class previews are now a thing too! If an item supports more than one class, you now see all of the icons for the supported classes in the previewer, and can swap between them to see how the item looks on every character.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TH61qvH.gif[/img]

We'll be continuing to improve the store going forward with more quality of life features such as browsing by category and adding filters to show only certain item types. Improvements to inventory sorting are also coming further down the line.

[h2][b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2]

We've been continuing to fine tune various classes lately in open testing, one of which is the Pachy...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/9025d872e57a23bfc3c5ca6440914526a51a4430.jpg[/img]

Its speed reduction has been mitigated somewhat this update with slightly better turning and faster acceleration, alongside a modest +50 health increase. Our next goal is to remove some of the friction that makes it still feel a little clunky. 

As of this patch it can now enter bracing faster when decelerating from a charge, but it's still not quite where we want it just yet. There are other adjustments to the class being considered, including a further change to how charge is handled, which we'll be experimenting with in testing over the next month or so. 

And it's a good day to be a Carno player, with our pointy headed friend now capable of receiving over triple the amount of health back on headbutt when its roar is active compared to before.

Wrapping up highlights for the saurian side, we have flipped the tables on Ptera and Tupa... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/2cc2ce0cdc6be08f371d3d547e7e6c4ce85c0cba.jpg[/img]

Our flying rammer now has the larger pool of health out of the two pterosaurs, to help with multi-hit engagements. To even out the two classes, Tupa's damage has been boosted a bit and Ptera has a smidge less survivability due to being able to carry targets away at high speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/be5875b009c32667e43c5109908590ffbcb05782.jpg[/img]

From what statistics we've been able to gather, Pyro was seeming to lag behind his fellows, so we've been progressively building him up over time. That includes his kit...

The Flameslammer has been further refined after its previous nerf, getting a little more kick. Incendiary grenades now burn a little hotter, dealing more damage over time, and incendiary explosions now pass through armour (the same as other explosives). The underslung slam shotgun of the Flameslammer also has better mid-range damage now.

It's not all about the new toy, though. Flamethrower users rejoice! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/c458c5fc4f9699ffec982a7118c6ead036d4e3f8.jpg[/img]

Proportional damage has been added to the Flamesaw's firejet, meaning that larger targets are hurt more when they are hit by it. The overpressure function has also been made much more forgiving, lasting twice as long and being more effective in general. 

Lastly, the Flaregun has received a boost to its afterburn damage. The fire no longer just tickles enemies, burning for up to a total of 96 damage instead of the paltry 17 it did previously. And if you haven't used it in a while, remember that critical hits from the Flaregun deal [i]triple damage![/i]

[h1]FULL CHANGELOG[/h1]

Check out all of the changes in version 2.9.9 below...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/1d88a80e7becf3e4f7e0e365bf58d35cd21cef47.png[/img]

[h2][b]Human Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased usable range of thrown health and ammo utility items
[*] Increased number of thrown ammo kit uses from 5 to 6
[*] Increased heal amount of thrown health kits from 10 to 12 per tick
[*] Increased blast radius of assault rifle grenades from 250 to 285
[*] Ensured all explosions have ArmourPiercing and ThrowRagdoll flags enabled

[*] Swapping between weapons is now faster with less of an artificial delay
[*] Throwable weapons such as zap traps / landmines now avoid clipping into eachother
[*] Jumping while scoped will now force you out of scope view
[*] Fixed pounce recovery animations not playing for anyone other than Scientist
[*] Added near-camera fading to bullet smoke trails so they don't have a hard cut-off
 
[*] Resized human physics assets to be larger to properly encompass the whole character, which may further improve dinosaur hit registration
[/list]
[h3][b]Scientist Overhaul:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW arrow type - Marking Arrows!
[*] Equip the bow and use the Special Ammo customization slot to select either explosive or marking. Tagged targets are revealed to all humans.
 
[*] NEW sci throwable - Speedgreed Energy Drinks
[*] Run over these to pick up an instant buff: sprinting is 1.2x faster, walking 1.35x faster (lasts 15 seconds)

[*] Gas Mines now automatically detonate after 1.6 seconds
[*] Increased the radius of gas mine poison clouds by ~25%
[*] Fixed gas mines stacking their effects when overlapping
[*] Increased gas duration from 12 to 15 secs
[*] Increased stamina drain from gas cloud

[*] NEW buff ability for the tranq pistol - shoot your friends!
[*] Human teammates receive health and armour that lasts for 20 seconds (shortened if they take damage)

[*] Significantly reduced the spread on tranq pistol
[*] Scientists receive assist points when their dart buff helps an ally survive an attack
[*] Humans with tranq pistol buff are outlined in blue
[/list]
[h3][b]Pyro Overhaul:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] improved mid-range damage for the flame slammer's slug shotgun
[*] increased burn tick damage of incendiary grenades from 15 per tick to 20
[*] made sure incendiary grenade explosions are armour piercing
[*] enabled ThrowRagdoll on incendiary grenades and added an impulse on death 

[*] Added proportional damage to the flamethrower - the larger the dino, the more it hurts.
[*] Increased base flame damage from 3.5 to 4.5 (is multiplied by proportional damage)
[*] Flamesaw overpressure now lasts about twice as long
[*] Reduced overpressure extra damage from 160% to 70%
[*] Reduced delay before pressure starts building again from 1.5 seconds to 1 second.

[*] Increased total DoT fire damage for Flaregun from 17 to 96
[/list]

[h2][b]Dinosaur Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved heavy damage reactions for Tyrannosaurus
[*] Updated the T.rex idle loop and movement animations with lower tail posture to make swipes easier
[/list]
[h3][b]Flyers:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased tupa health from 300 to 350
[*] Increased tupa flight collision tolerance
[*] Increased tupa air ram damage - minimum is now 40, max 70
[*] Increased max tupa divebomb damage from 90 to 100

[*] Reduced ptera health from 360 to 320
[*] Fixed ptera marking dead bodies
[*] Added head gore to Flyers!
[/list]
[h3][b]Spitters:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Made the spit to bite cooldown on dilo and cryo 50% shorter
[*] Added new more dangerous feeling Cryo acid in-air sounds
[*] Increased audible radius of spit in-air travel sounds and impacts
[*] Reduced "health" of dilo venom puddles when burned
[*] Tweaked the look of burned dilo puddle decals
[*] Fixed spit decals not spawning properly in solo mode
[*] Fixed cases where dilo spit would not extinguish molotov firepools
[/list]
[h3][b]Bruisers:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved sprint acceleration for Pachy
[*] Increased regular (un-roared) sprint speed of Pachy
[*] Made bracing cost slightly less for Pachy
[*] Pachy brace can be triggered sooner when slowing from sprint
[*] Pachy grazing speed only starts slowing down when past 65% full

[*] Increased max ravenous health regen from Carno charge hits from 85 to ~300!
[/list]
[h3][b]Other:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Slightly different UI hit sounds depending on whether you're shooting dino strongpoints or weakpoints

[*] Updated a few other HUD sounds, added "skillshot" kill sound (ricochet) for: 

[list]
[*] any multi-kill as human (grenades, usually)
[*] killing with a stungun zap
[*] killing a flyer that is in flight
[*] shooting charged spit out of the air
[*] solo tyrant killer
[*] cerato tail crit kill
[/list]
[*] Started overhauling the in-game store:

[list]
[*] Added multi-class previews for items that are usable by more than one character
[*] Added multi-item previews for bundles, allowing you to swap between all items in a pack
[*] Added previews for weapon skins and weapon packs

notes.content:
[i]Dinovember[/i] is almost over, and with the holidays approaching we are slowly but surely building up to our console beta. That means more fixes and feature tweaks added to PCE in today's patch...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/b3fa5b187ccf6523b3668bb603f00d5e479274be.png[/img]

Since every Trapper in the world has been using [i]zap traps[/i] the last couple weeks, a whole bunch of bugs and oversights with them were revealed that had not been seen before. 

This patch addresses a number of glitches with zap traps, from visual bugs such as bonus beams and falling through the floor, to more serious issues like shooting through walls. While the little zappers are still a very useful tool, their range and cumulative damage needed to be lowered a bit now that their hit detection is much improved. They're also now properly limited in how many can be placed in one area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/7369c59c42db58673362b42a49c6ef6cd9618cc0.jpg[/img]

Other traps have received similar treatment - land mines can't be stacked directly on top of each other anymore either. One spicy change is that Acro's stomp attack can now detonate any land mines or gas traps within range along with it deactivating bear traps. 

A small but important change to Trapper's dual pistols is that each of them can now be fired continuously. [b]Hold[/b] left mouse / left trigger to fire the left handgun automatically without needing to keep tapping, and right mouse / right trigger to do the same for the right handgun. This change comes from feedback that tapping to fire felt clunky, but we may investigate a gameplay settings option to choose between tap fire and hold fire in future for those who prefer the other method.

Elsewhere, dinosaurs now see the bleed status symbol in the corner when hit by the machete - useful now that there's a lot more people playing butcher(!). We've also started fixing a few issues with challenges that were not tracking properly, such as head shots on charging Pachycephalosaurs. 

There are a few other minor adjustments, such as Oviraptor not draining as much stamina when sprinting now, which you can view in the changelog below.
