[/list]
[h3][b]PRIZES[/b][/h3] [olist]
[*][b]First Place[/b] contestant gets a [b]mystery box[/b] containing a special assortment of goodies hand-picked by the Extinction team. 

[*][b]Second Place[/b] will also get 10 in-game items of their choosing. Additional $50 value towards any product on Steam. 

 [*][b]Third Place[/b] winner will be able to choose any 10 in-game items in the game of their choosing. [/olist]
[h3][b][i]We can't wait to see what you guys come up with this time![/i] [/b][/h3]

[h1][b]Winter Wrap-up[/b][/h1]
We're now in the fourth and final week of the [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/321360/Primal_Carnage_Extinction/]Extinction Winter Event[/url][/i], which means another set of cool new items is now live. Don't forget to check out the latest lineup and fire sale before the event is over! Who knows when they'll return?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/406883b55719c013a583cf12d11bbaf9068d847d.jpg[/img]

The response to the winter event has been incredible, it's great to see that even after five years, we still have a dedicated community supporting the game. And not just playing, but producing content every day that never fails to amaze and inspire us. 

You guys are the best! 

From awesome shots in the screenshots section to workshop maps to skins, it just never ends. I'm not saying the community is starting to make better stuff than we do...because I want to keep my job...but it's err close. Yeah. 

But forget that thought, check out this small sample of amazing stuff the community's been up to lately!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1970852023][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/8d2734daf0d6d86942b8d021f854f9b121c51424.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1950045366][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/9c7c3df626f4a54ea458574cf8b9ac5b7fd62157.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1950045366][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/9419899b7435fef14c27b80726bc36d5c31c4f93.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1970657189][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/409b7e9dee97f4ff3fd31c788f88785a3f6f268d.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/2805e02ebf9eb042d5128c042cd79a7c8d2dae1a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/baddfbad4ce60bf7c0dd0c855489c8cd7c3a5e1e.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1972313416][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/dde3d84dc87463d59c144f501c6ad448a44ec59a.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1971650003][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/e2c55820094f766416b6936d722ef81894877c7e.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1969136723&searchtext=][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/916fcfc850ec5b09599765a184ca710af011bc9a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Winter Update hotfix
notes.content:
A new patch for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] has been released. 

This hotfix should resolve some performance problems with new cosmetic items such as dino santa hats, mitigating server log spam that was causing severe slowdown. And, uh.. spiked Tyrannosaurs won't wear antlers wrapped around their feet anymore. We've also fixed the Oviraptor to properly mark mines for teammates. 

We hope this hotfix makes the winter event much smoother for everyone!

For more information on the latest major update, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791436599353/announcements/detail/1700603847638202991][i]read the Winter Event announcement[/i][/url].

notes.title: WINTER UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]WINTER IS HERE![/h1]
Today marks the beginning of the [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] [b]Winter Event![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/b67d46af44370b324624f448a8a423ed9e80b562.jpg[/img]

Yes, the decorations should be coming down soon and we're heading into a new decade, but we hope you'll forgive us for being [i]fashionably late[/i]. Not only is there a new update, but for the next few weeks we’ll be hosting special community events, introducing new winter store items and running fire sales!

One of the special events will be a new Winter Art Contest (with a fantastic prize for the winner). 
Details are coming soon, so keep an eye out!

And to read all about the dozens of gameplay changes, balance tweaks and bugfixes that come with the winter update, see the bottom of this post for the full changelog.

Now, it wouldn’t be the holidays without presents. 
[i]And speaking of presents…[/i]

 [h1]GIFTS ARE BACK[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/b93841a91d3b5725848738fbcf4a186cddbf754b.jpg[/img]

By popular demand, ALL gifts from past Winter updates have been brought back with the original 2015 gift 30% off right off the bat. In the past gifts awarded up to 16 players an item from that gift's selection. This year with their return, we decided that 16 seemed a little low, so to further celebrate the season of giving [b]we’ve bumped that up to 24[/b]. 

Gifts are also now [b][i]fully altruistic[/i][/b], making them a true act of generosity. The player who opens the gift is blessed with a warm feeling inside, knowing they have brought a little joy to the world.

In addition to legacy gifts returning, we also have an all-new gift debuting this winter. This gift has some items from the past and some exciting ones that have never been seen before! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/7ee3b3bcc4d034f320bf769972c0be6eec0f8467.jpg[/img]

[h1]FIRE SALES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/cd7b17a4d968dfa11abad1728365220041739957.jpg[/img]

A wide range of new skins, accessories and taunts arrive with this update, and over the next few weeks we'll be running [i][b]FIRE SALES [/b][/i]on selected items in the store! 

Both new and old items for a variety of classes will be rotating through, in addition to discounts on various winter themed items and cosmetics. Grab some hot deals while you can! 

Keep an eye out for announcements on the in-game news ticker, the Primal Carnage: Extinction [url=https://discord.gg/yzZxtw5]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/Primalcarnage/]Facebook[/url], or [url=https://twitter.com/primalcarnage]Twitter[/url] to know when new deals go live!

[h1]FULL RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
[b]General[/b][list]
[*] Added a new Admin command to ban players by Steam ID
[*] Removed joinspectators console command
[*] Fixed players not having an outline when carrying an egg in Capture the Egg
[*] Fixed Capture the Egg map rotation list not including ForestChasm
[*] Fixed deadly chopper blades sometimes present in Get To The Chopper mode
[*] Fixed pain sounds not playing properly in multiplayer
[*] Fixed Taunt sound effect distance being too small
[*] Fixed a controller bug where you’d be unable to move if holding down the use button
[*] Fixed in-game store featured window causing navigation problems
[*] Fixed Splash Screen not showing when launching the game
[*] Fixed proportions of the Spinosaurus Claw Pick taunt (Thanks, Waddigator!)
[*] Fixed collars misbehaving with the Abyssal Novaraptor quills (Thanks, Dr. Cuttlefish!)
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/5bdf7429cc43b8b56245002fe17ae9ab7ff2c985.jpg[/img]

[b]Human[/b]
[list]
[*] Added “Tyrant Takedown” bonus EXP for allies that assist killing a Tyrant
[*] Added a glowing outline to health and ammo pickups that appear when low on health/ammo
[*] Added Human VO cues every time a human picks up a health/ammo kit
[*] Fixed weapon spread modifiers not being applied when aiming / scoped / crouched 
[*] Fixed some damage types not blocking incoming Raptor pounces (Rejoice!)
[*] Fixed ammo pickups doing nothing while holding a melee weapon
[*] Increased MK Pistol and Dual Revolver maximum damage at long distances
[*] Reduced MK Pistol maximum recoil
[*] Reduced Human ragdoll total mass for visual reasons
[*] Added auto-reload functionality to the StunGun
[*] Added charred effect to bodies killed from electrical shock damage
[*] Increased StunGun effective range slightly
[*] Increased StunGun dinosaur stunned duration from 3.5 to 5 seconds
[*] Fixed Flyers not entering a fall state when being hit with shock damage
[*] Added Netgun “falling net” impact effect for solid surfaces
[*] Reduced Netgun net collision radius slightly
[*] Fixed Humans having full passive melee ability while aiming or reloading
[*] Fixed Trapper net-knife damage bonus so it only applies to small dinosaurs
[/list]
 [b]Dinosaur[/b]
[list]
[*] Added +15 EXP bonus to any player that gains a kill while buffed by a Tyrant
[*] Increased max step height for all dinosaurs classes except Tyrants
[*] Increased Carno knockback distance when colliding with a human
[*] Increased Oviraptor health from 200 to 240
[*] Increased Oviraptor stamina from 140 to 180
[*] Increased Oviraptor scent detection radius by 15%
[*] Increased Oviraptor max jump height and jump turn speed slightly
[*] Increased Oviraptor pounce maul damage slightly
[*] Oviraptor can now mark mines for teammates 
[*] Increased Tyrant roar buff range
[*] Reduced Tyrant roar buff duration from 40 to 30 seconds
[*] Reduced Tyrant netted duration from 12 to 10 seconds
[*] Reduced the amount of pain sounds a Tyrant plays while netted
[*] Fixed roar buffs for Rex and Spino not applying properly
[*] Fixed Acro stomp attack not knocking back players properly
[*] Fixed an issue where the human model wouldn’t sync with the Spino eating animation
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/f00a10b2c23fa56c7b545cbfc6522de0c6e5e2f2.jpg[/img]

[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
[*] Added some additional light sources to the darker areas of Docks
[*] Fixed a fence collision issue in DesertionPoint
[*] Fixed humans climbing onto surfaces not intended in Docks
[*] Fixed CTE jeeps not blocking players in UtilityBase
[*] Fixed an unintended particle effect being visible outside CTE in UtilityBase
[*] Fixed humans climbing onto a crane not intended in UtilityBase
[*] Fixed props for CTE mode being visible in Freeroam on Docks
[*] Fixed nest for CTE mode near human base glitching out in Docks
[*] Fixed alternate boat ramp not lowering properly in GTTC-Docks
[*] Fixed a fence not blocking anything in GTTC-Downpour
[*] Verdant buildings modified so Tyrants can access two of the three buildings
[*] Verdant layout improved with more access to the main central building
[*] Verdant fence, wall gaps, and pipe bridges widened for dinosaur player traversal
[*] Verdant human spawns removed from central building to prevent camping
[/list]
 
We hope this update warms things up!

And if you’ve yet to enter the Carnage, or have a friend who hasn’t had the pleasure, you can still enjoy a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Primal%20Carnage] cool 50% off the entire Primal Carnage franchise[/url] for the rest of the Steam Winter Sale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/41225fe64c0238b2d8b9660875c2db83f98947ab.jpg[/img]

Finally, from the whole Primal Carnage team,
[h2][i][b]Have a merry new year![/b][/i][/h2]

notes.title: Winter Update Teaser
notes.content:
A cold, dark chill is in the air. Winter is here, and the next Primal Carnage: Extinction game update is nearly upon us! With just a few days until the launch of our latest winter event, here is a little tease of what's stalking your way soon...

[previewyoutube=Gdedh5ALSBE;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of you may recall that Santa loved visiting our dinosaur island so much he decided to set up shop away from the north pole. Even trading reindeer for pterosaurs as our live-in festivity officer for a couple years there and keeping temperatures on the.. uh.. cool side. Fear not though, as winter will only last but a month this time round. The dinosaurs have started regarding jingle bells as the dinner bell at this point, so it's probably safer this way.

During the winter event there will be numerous discounts available from the in-game store, with new deals regularly appearing, so check back often if you're on the hunt for a new look!

In addition to a fountain of new festive fan-made skins, you can expect more game fixes and rebalancing. Issues with features such as tyrant roars have been resolved, further improvements to Capture The Egg mode are on the way and it's easier to find pickup items with them now being highlighted when you are low on health or ammo.

But this is just the tip of the iceberg, be sure to read the full winter update change notes on release! 

Also, if you haven't already- [url=https://discord.gg/yzZxtw5]don't forget to check out our Discord![/url]

notes.title: Talk, Toolkit, and Turkey
notes.content:
It's Thanksgiving and Steam is having another Autumn Sale!

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/215470/]Primal Carnage[/url][/i], [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/321360/]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/url][/i], and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/538790/]Primal Carnage: Onslaught[/url][/i] [b]are all 50% off[/b]. 

Grab a copy for you or a friend. Seize the moment and get a 4-pack. 
Treat yourself, you've earned it.

[h1][b]Extinction Developer Toolkit Update[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/79db8b6e44df87af7ba2ed5c4297cdee8d68f3b5.jpg[/img]

So, this Tuesday happened to be the glorious 3 year anniversary of the Extinction Development Toolkit's... uh.. last update.. 

Unfortunately, it used to be very difficult to compile editor builds, so as a result we did them less often. The issue is that the difference in content between the editor and live game caused problems. 

[b]GOOD NEWS[/b] - We've taken care of the compile issue [b]and today a new editor build will be live[/b]. In future, both the game and toolkit will receive updates at the same time.

Despite the pause in tool updates, the Primal community wasn't deterred. The team has been absolutely blown away by what you guys have created over the years. Some of what we've seen in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/321360/workshop/]Workshop[/url] is even higher quality than what we're able to produce (although you'd never hear us say that out loud!).

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/712877fa530006cdec364c610944d5fd66be3a9e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/b47253cf6a6f027909685d02dadbb8e780f7fc06.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/fe53d593be9c3a0870d0cd8207cd4f36687f0bfe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/24899a49b31d8c7d31b35df26871e8f63a59ad25.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/2d1ac20c35cc3078b5c30376bf5a39740ac0cc50.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/4e7eca95bbe0224e7b3332c82f911f8568a1bbae.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/7b17cf934c556ba14e02c5bd4ad49124b9d4bf7c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/df1887fe83dfa685cb99c5cc08a741e1e50b21b8.jpg[/img][/url] 

But we want to see [b]more. [/b]And we're dedicated to helping [i]anyone [/i]willing to give it a shot. Going forward, one of our priorities will be to create more tutorials and prefab content to help speed up the creation process for everyone. If you weren't already aware, you can find [url=http://primalcarnage.com/devwiki/index.php?title=Main_Page]the current developer wiki here[/url].

If you have any questions or interest in showing off your work you can ping [b]@Apoc[/b] and [b]@dinosauriac[/b] in the [b]#ExtinctionEditor[/b] section of [url=https://discord.gg/yzZxtw5]our Discord[/url]. They'll answer. [i]Or else![/i]

Besides that, we're also looking into hosting a few community contests, with Workshop maps and skins being the most likely categories.  If that interests you and you're thinking about diving in, don't wait until the last minute to start learning!

[h1][b]Map Stamps: How Are They?[/b][/h1]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/99a0034b93bbcdd29654a201338bd3ab926620d9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/9ecc95661d13b8ecd43b4aa728e12b178b5d6b22.png[/img][/url]
We wanted to let everyone know that [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/321360/announcements/detail/1606023815831654865]Map Stamps[/url] have been very popular! For those that aren't aware, each Community Workshop map we've implemented into the game comes with it's own Map Stamp. The creator of the map gets two thirds of all Stamp revenue, while those who purchase a stamp get a special item. Stamps provide a way to give something back to the creators for their hard work, similar to the system for Workshop skin authors.

We're always on the lookout for more candidates for the Map Stamp system, so if you have a concept you've been working on but haven't posted it...don't hesitate! We really do want to see it.

[h1][b]Extinction Store Feature - Turkey Week[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/c490f767996e5568d7128ed13aabcd2ab55c40e6.jpg[/img]

With [i]Spitter Week [/i]coming to a close, we now give attention to the long time fan favorite Turkey class with [b][i]Turkey Week[/i][/b]! 

If it's an Oviraptor or a Novaraptor with feathers on it, this week we're calling it a Turkey. And for humans players- it's open season on these guys. Especially for any hunter looking to catch a new exciting type of Turkey:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/4747b1aad9699183b4be51ca4449c07b74ae4dda.jpg[/img]

An Oviraptor!? With quills? This genetic experiment is clearly the work of a genius or someone pure evil.

We have three hot Oviraptor skins, an Ovi bundle, and two Feathered Raptors for this week's featured lineup. Along with that we're also cycling out several items that have been in for a few weeks for some brand new ones. What new ones? Check out the store and see for yourself!

[h1][b]Winter Update[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/eda6c1abcf93187a16b6e6e5ddeda3733c1d9909.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more information on what we'll be planning in [b]December[/b].
In the meantime...

[i]Happy Thanskgiving![/i]

notes.title: Dinovember Update
notes.content:
The Dinovember Update for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction[/i] has been released!
Read all about it...

[h1][b]STORE REFRESH[/b] [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/ef0e9681bbadb9695e5bb2531a687c3bf8faa0f5.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/321360/announcements/detail/1658940477385100260][b]Halloween Horrors[/b] [/url]is behind us, but we have some frightfully good new looks in-store for [i]Carnotaurus[/i]. This charging bruiser is the latest [b]featured class[/b] as part of our new regular store rotation, with several new community-created cosmetics available now, alongside a character skin pack for the Carno.

[h1][b]MAP STAMPS[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/99a0034b93bbcdd29654a201338bd3ab926620d9.png[/img]
In our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/321360/announcements/detail/1571119650807530689]last major update[/url] we added 3 new maps developed by our fans. We've loved seeing the positive response to these, and wanted to provide a way to give something back to the creators for their hard work. To that end, we are introducing Map Stamps to the store this month. 

Map makers will receive two thirds of all profits from stamp purchases. As well as supporting creators, there is a unique skin obtained by purchasing each map stamp for your generosity!

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/b][/h1]
As usual there are some balance adjustments and gameplay fixes included with this update... [list]
[*] Reduced default respawn time of ammo kits by 10 seconds
[*] Increased chainsaw damage from 210 to 212
[*] Significantly increased fire rate of standard pistol
[*] Reduced accuracy and effective range of standard pistol
[*] Reduced damage of standard pistol from 60 to 40
[*] Changed clip capacity of standard pistol from 15 to 9
[*] Fixed sniper rifle not using damage falloff
[*] Reduced damage at max range for sniper rifle
[*] Fixed dual pistols not using damage falloff
[*] Increased dual pistol damage from 45 to 50
[*] Reduced max sprint speed for Carnotaurus from 2.83x to 2.75x
[*] Slowed stamina regen rate for Carno from 20 to 15
[*] Reduced corpse heal rate from 150 / sec to 75 / sec for Carno
[*] Reduced minimum speed and distance required to successfully pounce
[*] Minor reduction to raptor pounce stamina usage
[/list]
[h1][b]MAP FIXES [/b][/h1] [list]
[*] Docks: fixed phantom health crates on TDM
[*] UtilityBase: fixed wall of invisible psychic energy on TDM
[*] UtilityBase: added another corpse to the compound area
[*] GTTC Ruthless: changed spawn point groups activated for spitters after first capture point
[*] GTTC Ruthless: fixed cave exit still blocking dinosaurs after point is taken
[*] GTTC Ruthless: Fixed resupply crates inside first human spawn not working
[*] GTTC Falls: fixed the main gate not unlocking properly
[*] PC-TheFalls: removed health pickup from inside the minidome
[*] Geothermal: fixed a couple of unusable pickup items
[/list]
[h1][b]GENERAL FIXES [/b][/h1] [list]
[*] Fixed the Acro not playing its Tyrant class music
[*] Increased audio max channels & streambuffer size to combat sound stuttering
[*] Fixed incorrect challenge requirements on tyrant swipe & stomp objectives
[*] Fixed points bonus for killing raptors who are pouncing teammates not working
[*] Fixed saviour kill challenge for killing raptors who are pouncing teammates 
[*] Potential fix for vote-kick causing crashes in some cases
[*] Fixed dark slime Acro & cavansite Acro skins not working properly
[*] Fixed missing detail on Battlescarred Ovi feathers
[*] Fixed ash and wavebreaker Tupa being swapped
[*] Fixed the Vigilant Pathfinder being bald. 
[/list]
[h1][b]LOADOUT INCONSISTENCIES[/b][/h1]
A while ago, the [b]throwable items[/b] for human classes were re-arranged. However, there was a bug where loadouts would not be properly validated, which sometimes caused the wrong items to appear equipped. 

The update *should* resolve this issue, but as a result everyone's loadout will be reset to default. You will need to re-equip your skins and weapons when next starting the game. 

Our apologies for the inconvenience. 

[h1][b]RANKING SYSTEM FIXES[/b][/h1]
Over the past few weeks a number of backend fixes have been deployed for the economy system. Challenges and rankup rewards should hopefully be working properly now after this latest patch. We will be continuing to put more checks in place server-side, to ensure that the system is working as intended. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7077945/bdb66a96f849bc906e723209cd7de7142ef4d4b1.png[/img]
Be sure to head on over to the[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/321360/discussions/3/] Issues & Bug Reporting[/url][/b] forum if you encounter any problems.

notes.title: Update 1.11 Now Available!
notes.content:
It's been a long time coming, but a new update for [i]Primal Carnage: Extinction [/i]has been released! 
Let's dig in, shall we?

[h1]COMMUNITY MAPS OFFICIALLY ADDED [/h1]
This update introduces [b]three[/b] brand new community-created maps, polished up for everyone to enjoy. From eerie abandoned facilities to far flung deserts, feast your eyes on the new locations being added:
[previewyoutube=qLEWINwwPhY;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][i]Sandstorm Valley[/i] [/b]by ArchShiranui & Sovicka is a giant canyon of rolling dunes with strong winds. We also have two maps by Chozobird; [b][i]Desertion Point [/i][/b] is a facility hidden deep inside an autumnal forest, and then there's[b] [i]Forgotten World[/i][/b]- a mysterious Freeroam map featuring death elevators and custom music. 

We're incredibly proud of the talent, time and effort put into these, and are happy to finally allow everyone to enjoy them as official maps.

[b]NOTE: [/b]If you have subscribed to the Workshop versions of these maps previously, you will need to unsubscribe from them or you will not be able to join servers running the official versions. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/321360/discussions/0/1607148447827485128/][u][b]Click for details.[/b][/u][/url]

[h1]CAPTURE MORE EGGS![/h1]
If you forgot about this mode, we forgive you. For the longest time, [i]Capture The Egg [/i]has gone unloved with only a single map to play it on. As of this update, we've expanded the mode to several more levels including: [b]Utility Base, Docks, Forest Chasm and Forgotten Outpost. [/b]Egg distribution varies between maps, some being quick jaunts back and forth, others having longer treks to retrieve your yolky prize. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/enQq9Yb.jpg[/img]
[i]
As a refresher, CTE works like this: [/i]

Red & blue team take turns capturing as mercs, while dinos resist them. Different nest types hold eggs of varying value, with the rarest red eggs furthest away. The team with the most egg capture points after two rounds wins. We've made it much easier to tell nest types apart now, and there's [b]greater EXP rewards [/b]for killing egg robbers or capturing eggs. 

[h1]EXPANDED & EVOLVING EXTINCTION STORE[/h1]
The in-game store has also been updated,[b] and will now rotate through different items every week[/b]! 
This week is [i]Tyrant Week[/i], so right now there's a collection of new [b]Acro, Rex and Spino[/b] skins featured.
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zFGbwyu.jpg[/img]

Class-themed bundles have been added as well (each holding 4 new skins). We'll be rotating through all of the classes over time, so don't worry if you miss this round.. your favourite class will be spotlighted again later. Check back regularly to see new items! 

You can also find [b]new dino taunts[/b] in-store, including a couple by our talented player Waddigator. In total there's [i]over 80 new items[/i] available [b]right now[/b], including over [i][b]20 [/b]free drop skins [/i]outside of the store.

[h1]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/h1]
After two months of playesting and refining PCE's game balance, we hope the changes we've made based on Open Testing feedback will make gameplay fairer and more enjoyable. 

[img]https://scontent-lhr3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/72459336_2786945107983602_8559644687332278272_n.jpg?_nc_cat=106&_nc_oc=AQmI2GpJNxTnmokzSJQHJFzqrs6zD2iRVl1pXWrR3EKmaSUunB_U6fCi_GAhXDtsFnU&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr3-1.xx&oh=e310fd63b556f9cf7bbff83e805bb3e6&oe=5E17A209[/img]

Chief among these is a fearsome boost to Tyrant health & stamina, giving low-skill players a better chance at using them. This means in the right hands Tyrants will be a serious threat, not just [i]annoying[/i]. But like all dinosaurs, they're weak to headshot damage. Skilled mercs can still solo Tyrants if they have good aim, just watch your ammo. 

And don't try netting them in the butt. 

As for humans, we've fixed issues with their weapon damage and stamina, but the biggest change is the [b]removal of resupply crates from Team Deathmatch[/b]. To get players moving around more, health & ammo crates have now been replaced by respawning pickup items.

[b]Ammo pickups [/b]award two reloads of primary & secondary ammo, plus a single throwable. [b]Health pickups[/b] will restore about half your health. On average these items respawn once a minute. They are also more numerous and spread out to more diverse locations than the old crates were. From what we've observed, this change makes Team Deathmatch more engaging and reduces the likelihood of humans camping. 

[h1]Would you like to know more?[/h1]
We have dozens of other balance adjustments in this update, from adding headshot bonuses for firearms to increasing Dilophosaurus bite potency.[b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/321360/discussions/0/1607148447827313370/]Check the full patch notes[/url][/b] for more details on these and all the other fixes and tweaks we've made! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8DpbSKs.jpg[/img]
With all of that out of the way, we hope you have fun with our latest fashionably late update.
And whether you're here to kill or chill, thank you all for playing.

notes.title: We're Back! (Soon)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/fe7ebc03e1ae388fb2b62792fc3b24736f8e0ece.jpg[/img]
That's right! We aren't extinct! 

It's been [i]65 million years[/i] since the last Primal Carnage: Extinction update, and we're back to tell you about some of what's coming next...

[h1][b]New Community Maps[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/74ea389e270e417bdc38a145e8a6431a52d40451.png[/img]
We've seen a lot of great fan-made maps on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/321360/workshop/]Workshop[/url], but unfortunately playing them right now is difficult. We're taking a few of our favourites and implementing them directly into the game proper, working with the creators to make improvements and smooth out the rough edges. 

[h1][b]Better Gamemode Support[/b][/h1]

Currently there's a lack of map support for Capture the Egg, which will be getting some improvements. We're also making it so that more maps will be properly usable in FreeRoam mode, such as the [i]Get to the Chopper[/i] levels.

[h1][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h1]

From fixing a lot of pesky bugs and various annoying gameplay issues, to [i]FINALLY GETTING THE MAIN MENU OUT OF CHRISTMAS MODE[/i], we're working to eliminate a lot of problems that have been lingering around for a while. 

[h1][b]Items, Items, Items![/b][/h1]

There may be a new skin in the game. Maybe two(!) if people want them badly enough. 
We'll think about it.

[h1][b]More to Come..[/b][/h1]

That's just[i] some[/i] of the things we're currently working on. 
Stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Update 1.9 and 1.9.1 Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/2d13418f1fb0366c6e5ed41924c77768fcf5d5ef.jpg[/img]
New updates to Primal Carnage: Extinction have been released! These updates will be applied automatically when you restart Steam or next launch the game. The major changes include:

[h1] [b] Challenge System [/b] [/h1]
[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/Challenges.jpg[/img]
We have added a new Challenge System which assigns you 3 random challenges per week. Completing challenges will reward you with a random cosmetic item. 

Challenge progress and items unlocked by completing them will now be displayed at the end of each round on a new info screen. Holding the Tab key will swap to displaying the scoreboard. Over the next few updates we're going to look at expanding this system with exciting new challenges and rewards.

[b] WARNING: [/b] [i]Challenge progress is only updated and saved at the end of every round. Leave early, and you will lose any unsaved progress. Challenges are only valid in TDM & GTTC modes. [/i]

[h1] [b] Human Voice Commands [/b] [/h1]
[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/CommandoHatShot.jpg[/img]
Humans now have two voice commands at their disposal: Call For Help (Z) and Call To Follow (C). Both commands have a 5 second cooldown to prevent abuse and also display the command as an event in the player chat.

[h1] [b]Server Support for Custom Maps [/b] [/h1]
[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/media_geothermal.jpg[/img]
Servers can now host player-created custom maps. If a server is hosting a custom map, players must subscribe to that map on the Workshop before being able to join it. Future updates will bring enhanced functionality to this new feature.

Dedicated servers subscribe to Workshop maps by adding something like this to DefaultGame.ini:
[code]
[Workshop.WorkshopInformation]
+SubscribedItems="672162366"
[/code]
Each +SubscribedItem id number is taken from the workshop map's URL.

[h1] [b] New Workshop Crate & Royal Dilo Pack [/b] [/h1]
[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/RoyalDilo.jpg[/img]
You can unlock a selection of hot new community-created skins in this August's Workshop Crate, dropping now! Also, check out the "DinoStore" for the new community-made Royal Dilo Pack.

[h1] [b] Changelog 1.9.1: [/b] [/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved global post process settings
[*]Lowered max pounce height range
[*]Potential fix for class limit/spawning issues
[*]Fixed missing archetypes for DNA strands  
[*]Fixed Royal Dilo skins not using the correct model
[*]Fixed the Royal and Pheonix Dilo skins being switched
[*]Fixed the Seagull Raptor not using the correct feathers
[*]Fixed the Riptide Spino with improved textures on authors request
[/list]
Currently the functionality of certain features is broken after the second round of a match starts. We are investigating the problem and hope to issue another hotifx in the coming week. 

[h1]  [b]Changelog 1.9.0: [/b] [/h1]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Class limits are now enabled by default
[*]Improved spawn distance weighting
[*]Fixed class availability and limits not updating correctly
[*]Fixed being unable to spawn in Survival mode
[*]Fixed Tyrants being available too early in Get To The Chopper
[/list]
[b]Humans[/b]
[list]
[*]Added auto-reloading for the Netgun and AR Grenade firemod
[*]Killing yourself with the grenade launcher now counts towards being suicide-kicked
[*]Stungun screen effect now lasts longer and is more intense

[*]Decreased Tranq Pistol fire rate slightly

[*]Increased Hatchet travel arc and speed
[*]Increased Landmine lifetime from 45 to 90 seconds

[*]Fixed Throwable Ammo Kit not restocking secondary ammo
[*]Fixed Throwable Ammo/Health Kit awarding points to dead players

[/list]
[b]Dinosaurs[/b]

[*]Increased Raptor/Oviraptor maximum pounce distance

[/list]
[list]

[/list]

New updates to Primal Carnage: Extinction have been released! These updates will be applied automatically when you restart Steam or next launch the game. The major changes include:

[h1] [b] Challenge System [/b] [/h1]
[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/Challenges.jpg[/img]
We have added a new Challenge System which assigns you 3 random challenges per week. Completing challenges will reward you with a random cosmetic item. 

Challenge progress and items unlocked by completing them will now be displayed at the end of each round on a new info screen. Holding the Tab key will swap to displaying the scoreboard. Over the next few updates we're going to look at expanding this system with exciting new challenges and rewards.

[b] WARNING: [/b] [i]Challenge progress is only updated and saved at the end of every round. Leave early, and you will lose any unsaved progress. Challenges are only valid in TDM & GTTC modes. [/i]

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/CommandoHatShot.jpg[/img]

[code]
[Workshop.WorkshopInformation]

notes.title: Community Update #4 - Evolving Gameplay
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/fe7ebc03e1ae388fb2b62792fc3b24736f8e0ece.jpg[/img]
In the last few community updates we've shared some of the upcoming improvements being made to Primal Carnage: Extinction, but ultimately all the new features in the world need to be supported by excellent core gameplay, and that’s an area we’re continually looking to refine.
 
To that end, we're going to be introducing some major changes that we hope will improve the balance, fun factor and longevity of the game. 

First and foremost, some of these will be large scale core gameplay changes that we want extensive testing and feedback on, so they will [b]not[/b] be making their way into our next major update (due in a few weeks). The improvements we're currently planning will focus on a few key aspects of gameplay...
 
[h1]Importance of Tyrants[/h1]
Tyrants have always played a major part in Primal Carnage's core gameplay, but we feel like they could be more menacing and powerful than they are now. In Team Deathmatch, we plan on making Tyrants unavailable for general selection and instead making them a timed "reward" for the Dino team. Every few minutes a random player will be re-spawned as a Tyrant to help sway the game in their team's favor. 

Once a player is selected to be Tyrant, they will be able to pick which of the three species they wish to play as. Alternatively, the chosen player can reject their selection as tyrant, which will prompt a different player to be offered the role. Our first implementation of this feature will likely be weighted so that there's a higher chance of players with high scores being chosen, but everyone else is still in with a shot at being selected. 

Naturally, all Tyrants will receive a buff to ensure they provide both a big impact for their team, and make them a bigger focus for the Human team. Something that's perhaps worth a few extra points to take down as well. 
 
[h1]Human Roles[/h1]
The dinosaur classes have great diversity and we want to further differentiate the Human classes to match. Promoting teamwork and increasing the overall mechanical depth are our main goals here. We’re going to refine the Human gameplay to better support the theming of each particular character. This will involve tweaks to a number of stats such as health, movement speed, stamina, and more that will be extensively tested. 

We'll also look at making changes to loadouts to help improve character utilities - for instance, the Scientist as a long-range character maybe shouldn't have the health pack.
 
[h1]Gameplay Pace[/h1]
To help support the refinements to many of the classes, we’ll be adjusting some of the pacing of the game. The goal of this is to enable all classes and roles to impact the game in a more positive way, helping to increase the overall suspense, strategy and tactics of the game.
 
[h1]Bringing it all together[/h1]
These changes will apply across the board in all game-modes. In TDM and CTE, Tyrant Selection will be semi-random every few minutes. Player feedback and information from our Open Testing sessions will help inform our decisions here. In GTTC, after Humans make a certain amount of progress, Tyrants will start getting chosen and assigned to players.

For those of you that enjoy Team Deathmatch the way it is right now, rest assured that we will also be including a "Classic TDM" mode with the normal Tyrant selection options we have currently. However, the majority of the other balance changes will apply across both game-modes.
 
[h1]Platform for the future[/h1]
Ultimately we feel like these changes are the right direction to take Primal Carnage: Extinction to help improve longevity. The updated gamemodes and gameplay balance will serve as a basis for ongoing enhancements, improvements and new additions into the future. We will continue to improve Primal Carnage: Extinction to make it a game you can enjoy for years to come.

As always, if you'd like to get involved in the discussions about our upcoming changes, or meet new players, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/yswyS5x]Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: Community Update #3 - Enhancements
notes.content:
This week we're here to talk about some general improvements and enhancements we're bringing into the next update of Primal Carnage: Extinction!

[h1]Stat-Track[/h1]
Stat-Track items are a bit of an unloved area of PCE. Initially we wanted to make Stat-Track items feel a bit more special and unique by having them only drop from limited crates.
Since we added them, we've found that players haven't engaged with them as much as we expected. So we're going to be adjusting how players get Stat-Track items. From our next major update, Stat-Track items will be craftable using Stat-Track DNA Strands, which will have a small chance of being the 2nd item dropped from crates. Use them like a normal DNA strand and the resultant item will have Stat-Track applied to it!
We're also looking at a way to bring Stat-Track onto human weapon skins.

[h1]End Game Information[/h1]
With the addition of the progression system and challenges, one of our goals has been to provide a better summary for players at the end of a round for how they did. We've been working on mocking up an example of what a new end-game screen might look like in the next major update, which includes challenge progress, unlocks and a match XP report! The below image is conceptual only and may not represent the final look and feel.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/c9c3339ec05f7c4ff1b02111f2333a3c38db717f.jpg[/img]

[h1]General[/h1]
We've added a secondary slot for Dino Cosmetics, meaning you can wear earmuffs and a collar at the same time!
We're continuing to add more assist types to reward teamwork and working on improving some of our in-game notifications for ammo and health support
Finally, the level cap will be further increased in the next major update!

Our next open testing session is still a few weeks away, but please join our [url=https://discord.gg/yswyS5x]Discord Chat[/url] to get notifications of when our new builds come out for testing!

notes.title: Community Update #2 - Challenges!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/860faab984d535430137b7731171b5f0efb096d9.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the second Primal Carnage community update. This week, we're focusing on a brand new feature that is coming to Primal Carnage: Extinction!

[h1][b]Weekly Challenges[/b] [/h1]

Challenges is something we've been wanting to bring into the game for a long time. We've finally got the opportunity to introduce them as part of some broader changes coming in the next major update to the game. 

Each week, players will get 3 weekly challenges to complete, such as "Kill 500 Enemies", "Win 10 TDM Games" or "Kill 100 Dinosaurs with throwable weapons". In the first iteration of challenges, we'll have pretty general, less specialized goals, however going forward we hope to introduce more specific ones to encourage players to try new classes and gameplay mechanics. 

Completing a weekly challenge will award you with an item drop of Common, Uncommon, or Rare quality. During seasonal events (ie Christmas or Halloween), Challenges will also be a way of getting themed cosmetic skins.

[h1][b]1.8.4 Release[/b] [/h1]

We're aiming to release minor update 1.8.4 this week, which includes some further GTTC map fixes, improvements to damage tick for spitter pools and fixes to some other inconsistent weapon behaviors. 

[h1][b]Workshop Update[/b] [/h1]

We'd like to remind the community to continue engaging with our workshop and content creators! We continue getting outstanding submissions to the PCE workshop. We expect to include several dozen new Community skins in our next major update, scheduled for later this year.

To vote on your favorite items, head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/321360/workshop/]Workshop[/url] section and check them out!

As for full custom map support, we're also working hard on finalizing that feature and it should be available in our next major update.

In the first iteration of challenges, we'll have pretty general, less specialized goals, however going forward we hope to introduce more specific ones to encourage players to try new classes and gameplay mechanics. 

Completing a weekly challenge will award you with an item drop of Common, Uncommon, or Rare quality. During seasonal events (ie Christmas or Halloween), Challenges will also be a way of getting themed cosmetic skins.

[h1][b]1.8.4 Release[/b] [/h1]

We're aiming to release minor update 1.8.4 this week, which includes some further GTTC map fixes, improvements to damage tick for spitter pools and fixes to some other inconsistent weapon behaviors. 

[h1][b]Workshop Update[/b] [/h1]

We'd like to remind the community to continue engaging with our workshop and content creators! We continue getting outstanding submissions to the PCE workshop. We expect to include several dozen new Community skins in our next major update, scheduled for later this year.

To vote on your favorite items, head over to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/321360/workshop/]Workshop[/url] section and check them out!

As for full custom map support, we're also working hard on finalizing that feature and it should be available in our next major update.

notes.title: Community Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/9c34bc2248035ff7727e26660580d0016ebf7ab9.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the first (of hopefully many) new Community Updates! As developers we've come to realize we don't communicate with you, our community, enough. With these more regular updates, we aim to keep you up to date with all the latest Primal Carnage franchise news, including upcoming features in PC Extinction and more...

[h1] [b] Humble Bundle - Welcome & Last Days[/b][/h1]

We were lucky enough to be part of the "Hooked On Multiplayer Bundle" recently, which has sold over 100,000 copies and contributed hundreds of thousands of dollars to supporting 3 great charities!

We warmly welcome all our new players that have joined us through the Humble Bundle, and urge that anyone who has yet to purchase takes advantage of this great bundle by heading over to [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/hooked-on-multiplayer-bundle ] the Humble site[/url]  to get some great games and support these worthwhile causes.

[h1][b]Economy server updates[/b][/h1]

Some new players might have noticed that there were a few issues with economy system connectivity over the past week or so. We believe we've identified these issues and resolved them, so all of our new players should receive drops and items on levelling up! 

Having a stable and thriving economy over a long period of time is very important to Primal Carnage Extinction's success, so we'll be continuing to invest in improving both our servers, and the game's interaction with our servers.

[h1][b]Official Servers - Update [/b][/h1]

We've been working hard to improve our official server offerings across the world. Last week we introduced 3 servers for our Australia & New Zealand players, and we're working on re-introducing official servers across West, Central and East USA, as well as across Europe. Keep an eye out in the server browser for our Official Servers running Team Deathmatch and Get To The Chopper!

If you're interested in hosting your own server, you can rent servers for just 99c/Slot from our official server hosts, [url=http://eoreality.net/]End Of Reality[/url].

[h1][b]Minor update due soon - come join Open Testing[/b][/h1]

Finally, we're working on both a minor balance and bugfix update due out in the next few weeks, as well as our next major set of features for a larger update in the next few months. If you want to follow along with the progress and help us continue to improve the game, please join our Open Testing sessions, which are run every week by community member TheSlayerNL. 

You can follow along with Open Testing news and join in discussions and feature suggestions on our [url=https://discord.gg/yswyS5x]Official Discord Channel[/url].

Credit to user [i]ServerNotFound [/i] for the header image!

notes.title: Patch 1.8.3 Now Available
notes.content:
[b]Las Vegas, NV – March 27th, 2017 [/b]– An update to Primal Carnage: Extinction has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Primal Carnage: Extinction.

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added custom roars for Cryolophosaurus and Oviraptor
[*]Overhauled maps in Get to the Chopper mode with new dynamic blockers and more consistent capture point settings 
[*]Continued economy improvements
[*]Added 4 new Store items from community workshop contributors
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[*]Reduced grenade launcher area of effect radius from 300 to 145
[*]Disabled roaring while stunned for all Tyrants and Carnotaurus
[*]Increased damage of Carno head swipe from 50 to 80
[*]Increased max damage of Carno charge from 75 to 85
[*]Increased Cryo spit stamina cost from 25 to 30 
[*]Increased raptor pounce cooldown from 1.5 to 2 seconds 
[*]Increased max pounce distance & pounce height
[*]Reduced range & duration of raptor melee attacks 
[*]Reduced raptor melee cooldown slightly
[*]Increased frenzy stamina drain speed 
[*]Increased raptor maul stamina cost 
[*]Lowered raptor sprint stamina cost 
[*]Increased Oviraptor maul damage from 20 to 25 
[*]Increased Oviraptor pounce stamina cost to be roughly equal to Novaraptor 
[*]Made tyrant head turning more responsive
[*]Increased stomp damage of Acro from 100 to 200 
[*]Reduced knockback on all grenade types, stomps, swipes and kicks 
[*]Lowered speed threshold for trample damage from Tyrants, increased trample damage
[*]Increased airspeed required before Tupa charge activates to stop it occurring on takeoff 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[*]Fixed plants in all maps from blocking weapons fire / spit 
[*]Fixed: being unable to choose a class in Survival mode
[*]Fixed: trace length and radius of Cryo spit so that it doesn't hurt through walls 
[*]Fixed: view offsets on flamesaw, flaregun, revolvers & shotgun to prevent view clipping 
[*]Fixed: crouch offset for flyers + adjusted their collisions 
[*]Increased projection height of Cryo spit decals 
[*]Made helicopter collisions more accurate 
[*]Fixed default class limit for Acro being set to zero in TDM 

[h1]Economy Updates[/h1]
[*]Added links to Workshop and Steam Marketplace on main menu 
[*]Added a news feed on the main menu
[*]Fixed inventory not refreshing after opening a crate or using nametags and description tags
[*]Fixed item popup from level up
[*]Fixed seams on the Algae Spino skin 
[*]Fixed the Doombringer Tupa appearing overly dark at skin maker's request 
[*]Tweaked the Crystal-Eyed & Canadian Oviraptor skins based on community feedback 

[h1]Map Updates[/h1]
[*]Updated main menu map, removed winter theme 
[*]Reworked the base camp area on Contingency 
[*]Updated the blocking volumes on Docks to be a lot less complex 
[*]Rebuilt lighting on Airbase at higher quality
[*]Adjusted pop-in of certain objects on Geothermal 
[*]Updated the BasicTest map with more objects / areas + spawnpoints
[*]Added more resupply objects to all GTTC maps
[*]Fixed choppers not showing in a couple of cinematic sequences
[*]Stopped certain choppers being visibility culled at a distance 
[*]Fixed draw distance of waterfall effects on GTTC-Falls
[*]Fixed landscape black spots on GTTC-Falls 
[*]Fixed unusable health box near objective C on GTTC-Falls
[*]Lowered height of first gate on GTTC Falls to prevent Tyrants exiting the dome 
[*]Changed lighting of GTTC-Falls dome objectives to better illuminate the capture points 
[*]Optimized Airbase some more, removed unnecessary complexity from rain shader 
[*]Fixed dome wire mesh disappearing at certain angles and lighting weirdly 
[*]Fixed GTTC-Docks customization area being backlit / overly dark
[*]Made capture point A markers more accurate on GTTC-Docks
[*]Fixed missing interior ambience of GTTC-Docks point A 
[*]Updated lighting & effects on GTTC-Docks 

[h1]Miscellaneous Tweaks[/h1]
[*]Adjusted global post processing effects 
[*]Master shader optimizations / improvements
[*]Tweaked certain particle effects, adding both higher & lower detail level versions 
[*]Increased volume & audible radius of distant tyrant steps
[*]Changed physics mass and momentum settings of ragdolls 
[*]Performance saving: can no longer manipulate ragdolls 
[*]Optimized number of active physics bodies on each character to reduce CPU load
[*]Updated audio device settings which might stop sounds failing to play in some cases
[*]Increased buffer time of audio which should reduce hitching 
[*]Increased max smoothed framerate to 240 
[*]Recompressed music assets 
[*]Reduced fade time of LOD textures 
[*]Added a timeout for loading maps

notes.title: Patch 1.8.2 Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/ca3a4aba1c6f4588053cb83adc313431aa8ec642.jpg[/img]

[b]Las Vegas, NV – January 30th, 2017[/b] – An update to Primal Carnage: Extinction has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Primal Carnage: Extinction. The major changes include:

This patch brings a very large update to the authorization scheme that we use for the Steam economy. As a result, we’ve had to update and rewrite a bunch of our economy functionality for this release. While we’ve tested this thoroughly, please be on the lookout for anything we may have missed.

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Introduced a new authorization scheme for the economy for improved security
[*]Re-enabled crafting!
[*]Re-worked certain economy calls for improved reliability and stability
[*]Fixed issues with certain economy skins from the Winter update
[*]Fixed seams on the Algae Spino
[*]Fixed collision on certain foliage in PC-ForestChasmSnow
[/list]
[h1]Dinosaurs[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced Cryo RoarCooldown from 45 to 40 seconds
[*]Reduced Cryo SpitStaminaCost from 35 to 25
[*]Increased Raptor PounceDelay from 1.35 to 1.5 seconds
[/list]

Thanks to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/brute0808]War Bear[/url] for the banner image!

notes.title: Current Economy Issues
notes.content:
We are currently aware of several issues that players are having with the economy, including no drops being awarded, crafting not being functional, and stat-track items not updating.

With regards to crafting, we were informed of an exploit relating to crafting, so we have disabled it until we are able to fix this exploit.

We are currently investigating the cause of drops not working, however a fix may not be deployed until version 1.8.2. To account for the time without drops, we'll also be running a Double Drop Week in the near future.

1.8.2 will bring various improvements to the security of the economy, as well as a variety of general fixes and improvements.

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/HalloweenUpdate1280.jpg[/img]

[b]Las Vegas, NV - October 29th, 2016[/b] - An update to Primal Carnage: Extinction has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Primal Carnage: Extinction. The major changes include:

[h1]Halloween, Primal Carnage 4th Anniversary[/h1]

This weekend marks four years since the original Primal Carnage was released - four years of fast-paced deathmatches, nail-biting chopper rescues and oddball hijinks! 

To celebrate, today we launch version 1.7 of Primal Carnage Extinction, and will be running the Primal Anniversary Celebration for the next few weeks. Halloween is also in the air and brings with it a raft of new community-created cosmetics and scarily good time-limited deals.

But wait, there's more! Everyone who plays Primal Carnage: Extinction during the Halloween update period will receive the Anniversary Gift, which includes a Primal Carnage 4th Anniversary Hat and a supply of crafting materials on the house.

This update features a new community crate and gift containing around 40 workshop items from the recent Halloween Workshop contest.  We were overwhelmed by the amount of fantastic entries! We're going to look at doing more stuff like this in the future. 

On behalf of the Primal Carnage Team, we thank you all for your continued support for the last four years and look forward to many more!


[h1]Update 1.7[/h1]

[u][b]General[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Reduced general network traffic, improving latency and load times 
[*]Improved spawn system (Spawn closer to allies, away from enemies)
[*]Maximum progression rank increased to 50
[*]Class change no longer forces a suicide in multiplayer
[*]Changed the first intro splash screen to be unskippable to prevent a crash
[*]Improved controller button layout
[*]Improved and refined certain weapon sound effects
[*]Improved performance across all maps 
[*]Added LODs to several particle effects across the game for performance 
[*]Added more sound cues to dinosaur movement animations
[*]Added auto-balance to GTTC
[*]Added "Killed Restrainer" assist for pounced Raptors
[*]Fixed several different crash cases 
[*]Fixed an issue where you would be unable to select a team when joining a match 
[*]Fixed a delay before being able to select a character 
[*]Fixed round timer displaying the wrong time when joining a match 
[*]Fixed the server browser not using bAntiCheatProtected which caused issues 
[*]Fixed player score being kept when changing teams/rounds 
[*]Fixed assists awarding 0 or over 100 points  
[*]Fixed players being able to move while taunting 
[*]Fixed a wide range of audio performance issues 
[*]Fixed certain customization items not showing up 
[*]Fixed the customization menu not working while dead/taking damage 
[*]Fixed the inventory screen not minimizing when character select is "requested"
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause incorrect playercount showing in class select 
[*]Fixed certain hints showing at the incorrect time 
[*]Fixed certain GTTC objects not having completion text 
[*]Fixed dozens of issues across all maps
[/list]

[u][b]Dinosaurs[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Cryo acid pool now does damage in a circle rather than a half circle
[*]Increased Cryo acid pool damage interval from 0.7 to 1.2 
[*]Increased Cryo acid pool radius from 60 to 90
[*]Decreased Cryo acid pool damage from 50 to 35
[*]Decreased Dilo spit instant hit damage from 40 to 10  
[*]Disabled the ability for the Carno to bite while sprinting 
[*]Disabled the ability for the Tupa to bite while flying at high speeds
[*]Decreased the intensity of the Dilo/Cryo spit overlay 
[*]Decreased Raptor pounce cooldown from 0 to 1.2 seconds
[*]Increased stamina cost of raptor mauling from 5/s to 6/s
[*]Standardized roar cooldowns to 60 seconds for all Tyrants
[*]Increased T-Rex health from 2750 to 3000
[*]Increased Spino health from 3000 to 3600
[*]Increased Spino secondary attack stamina cost 
[*]Increased Acro healing buff from 2/s to 6/s
[*]Increased Acro attack bite range
[*]Fixed headshot zone for the Carno being at knee height 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Ptera wouldn't drop humans when shot 
[*]Fixed the Overdose achievement not being valid for all Tyrants 
[*]Changed the tranquilizer overlay effect
[/list]

[u][b]Humans[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Enabled head loss for melee weapons
[*]Disabled head loss for tranq/stun damage 
[*]Increased human melee critical multiplier 
[*]Added crosshair to melee weapons 
[*]Molotov now sets enemies on fire on direct hit 
[*]Molotov fire pool now ignites enemies that walk through it
[*]Flamesaw chainsaw attack now blocks raptor pounces 
[*]Increased explosion radius of the "Pyro Bomb" mechanic
[*]Increased Flamesaw flame damage range by 50%
[*]Increased Flamesaw flame damage from 2 to 2.5
[*]Increased Dual Colt damage from 46 to 50
[*]Increased Desert Eagle damage from 95 to 105
[*]Increased M9 Pistol damage from 50 to 60
[*]Increased Assault Rifle grenade launcher damage from 315 to 400
[*]Increased Assault Rifle grenade launcher radius from 200 to 225
[*]Increased Tranq Rifle effective damage range 
[*]Decreased Stun Gun fire delay from 0.2 to 0.15
[*]Decreased Stun Gun spread from 0.2 to 0
[*]Disabled headshot critical multiplier for all shotguns and explosives
[*]Decreased SPAS12 spread from 0.35 to 0.25
[*]Decreased Shotgun/SPAS12 effective damage range slightly
[*]Decreased Double Barrel Shotgun effective damage range significantly
[*]Decreased DBS fire rate from 0.6 to 1.12 seconds
[*]Decreased DBS secondary fire spread 
[*]Decreased DBS hit momentum from 10 to 4
[*]Increased DBS recoil slightly 
[*]Increased throwable medkit uses from 5 to 15
[*]Decreased throwable medkit heal rate from 50/s to 10/s
[*]Fixed humans being able to detonate Trapper landmines 
[*]Fixed AR grenades not damaging the T-Rex when shot in the head 
[*]Fixed the Molotov from sometimes creating a fire pool in mid-air 
[*]Fixed the Molotov and grenade explosions causing a high knockback 
[*]Fixed human pounced dialog not playing properly 
[*]Fixed landmines not having an impact sound 
[*]Fixed humans being able to use resupply items while pounced 
[*]Fixed being able to reload during a weapon switch 
[*]Fixed the Shotgun/SPAS12 reloading animations 
[*]Fixed flamethrower sometimes igniting allies after death 
[*]Fixed Assault Rifle weapon skins not showing up in third person 
[*]Fixed the Commando not having a default taunt in the loadout menu 
[*]Fixed certain weapons not having KillIcons 
[*]Fixed certain weapons being missing from the class select screen 
[/list]

[u][b]Economy[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Added Halloween 2016 Gift 
[*]Added Halloween 2016 Crate 
[*]Added Halloween 2016 Key 
[/list]

[u][b] Known Issues [/b][/u]

There are unfortunately a handful of unexpected issues. We will be fixing these in the next patch:
[*]Anniversary Gift can only be opened when playing on a server 
[*]Changing classes can sometimes cause the wrong skin being applied 
[*]Skins are not correctly showing in Survival mode
[*]Issues starting up Hunt mode
[*]Lighting error on Airbase

notes.title: September Newsletter
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7077945/36533cfdfc22ab9f548eada3bfafc34650460ad4.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone! Time for a quick status report on the next major update. Work on Version 1.7 is progressing well and you can expect it to be released at the end of October. The next few weeks will be spent rigourously testing all changes.

We have some exciting plans that we’re waiting to hatch, and will be talking more about those closer to the anniversary of the original Primal Carnage’s launch. For now, we can say that to commemorate four years of dinosaurs vs. humans, we will be running a special Anniversary Celebration event to coincide with the update. Expect some in-game discounts and special deals!

[h1] [b] What is included in Version 1.7?  [/b] [/h1]

You asked us to focus on bug fixing and balance, that’s exactly what we have done. With the help of our Open Testing participants we have been tracking down and eliminating bugs, tweaking weapons, adjusting classes and evaluating performance. 

Every map has had yet more collision fixes, layout adjustments and lighting refinements. We’ve also gone through our assets and optimized a lot of content, meaning that the game should run a little faster, use less memory and require less disk space after the next update. Substantial time has been spent improving our network traffic use as well, which should result in better network performance and reliability.

In addition to a whole slew of bugfixes and balance improvements, other new features will include:

-Improved spawning system
-Higher progression system level cap
-Adjustments to the Autobalance system and voting system
-More assist types and improvements to how we reward teamplay

[h1] [b] Halloween Skin Contest [/b]  [/h1]

As we head towards that spooky time of year, we will be running a special Halloween-themed skin competition! 

Create your skin using the Primal Carnage: Extinction SDK and submit it to the Workshop for your chance to be included in a Halloween store pack or crate. To take part, simply submit your skin to the workshop using the Halloween 2016 tag, then go vote on your favorite skins! You have until October 21st to submit your ideas. 

We look forward to sharing more information as we get closer to the Anniversary Celebration, and thank you for your patience as we thoroughly test this next update. 

*Credit goes to War Bear for yet another great header image!

notes.title: Update 1.6 Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/CTEUpdateBannerUpdateText2.jpg[/img]

[b]Las Vegas, NV - July 28th, 2016[/b] - An update to Primal Carnage: Extinction has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Primal Carnage: Extinction. The major changes include: 

[h1]CTE[/h1]

The situation on the island is a mess, but Phoenix Corporation still wants to preserve its research! The human team needs to collect as many egg specimens as possible, while the dinosaur team protects their unhatched young from those pesky poachers. There are three types of nests with 2, 5 and 10 point eggs.

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/EggPoints.jpg[/img]

[h1]Level Progression, New Scoring System[/h1]

This update also features a level progression and new scoring system. The former is bare-bones at the moment, but more will be added in the future. Each level will give you a random item. You gain XP from in-game actions such as kills, assists, captures, etc.

The server browser will show you which servers are progression system enabled. What defines whether your server is eligible for progression is the gamemode currently running. The only gamemode where progression isn’t enabled is Freeroam. XP is not awarded to admins using godmode or the change size command.

To match this new system, scoring has changed. Kills are now worth 100 points. GTTC objects now give points as well. You will now gain 250 points for primary objectives and 125 for secondary objectives. 

[h1]Assists[/h1]

The assist system has been overhauled. Assists now score based on the percentage of damage you did to the enemy rather than a set score. These points are added to your total score, and therefore assists have been removed from the scoreboard. 

[list]
[*]Assists now show the type in the score popup
[*]Added “Stun” assist type 
[*]Added “Tranq” assist type
[*]Added “Capture Kill” assist type for dinosaurs that kill a human while capturing
[*]Fixed assists not being awarded to dead players
[/list] 

[h1]Team Auto-Assign[/h1]

On community request, players are now automatically assigned to a team by default in TDM, GTTC, and CTE. Once assigned to that team, there is no option to switch teams. This should go a long way to prevent the famous “Dino-Hogging” issue. This also removes spectator on servers using Team Auto-Assign, which prevents even more exploits. 

If you are a server owner and you wish to disable this, add this to the startup commandline:

[code]?bAutoAssignTeam=false[/code]

[h1]Economy and Store[/h1]

With this update, we've added over 60 new community items from the Workshop!

To support this huge addition of items, we're bringing back the popular Christmas Gift in the form of the Summer Gift 2016 for a limited time!

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/Store7_Landscape.jpg[/img]

In addition to this, we've added a new Workshop Celebration Crate. This crate has it's own key, which is now in the store. The store also has a limited time item and two new bundles:

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/Store8.jpg[/img]



[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[b]Humans[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased DB Shotgun per-shell damage from 50 to 35
[*]Increased the speed of the Flaregun projectile
[*]Fixed Assault Rifle grenade having a timed explosion
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6 Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/CTEUpdateBannerUpdateText2.jpg[/img]

[b]Las Vegas, NV - July 28th, 2016[/b] - An update to Primal Carnage: Extinction has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Primal Carnage: Extinction. The major changes include: 

[h1]CTE[/h1]

The situation on the island is a mess, but Phoenix Corporation still wants to preserve its research! The human team needs to collect as many egg specimens as possible, while the dinosaur team protects their unhatched young from those pesky poachers. There are three types of nests with 2, 5 and 10 point eggs.

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/EggPoints.jpg[/img]

[h1]Level Progression, New Scoring System[/h1]

This update also features a level progression and new scoring system. The former is bare-bones at the moment, but more will be added in the future. Each level will give you a random item. You gain XP from in-game actions such as kills, assists, captures, etc.

The server browser will show you which servers are progression system enabled. What defines whether your server is eligible for progression is the gamemode currently running. The only gamemode where progression isn’t enabled is Freeroam. XP is not awarded to admins using godmode or the change size command.

To match this new system, scoring has changed. Kills are now worth 100 points. GTTC objects now give points as well. You will now gain 250 points for primary objectives and 125 for secondary objectives. 

[h1]Assists[/h1]

The assist system has been overhauled. Assists now score based on the percentage of damage you did to the enemy rather than a set score. These points are added to your total score, and therefore assists have been removed from the scoreboard. 

[list]
[*]Assists now show the type in the score popup
[*]Added “Stun” assist type 
[*]Added “Tranq” assist type
[*]Added “Capture Kill” assist type for dinosaurs that kill a human while capturing
[*]Fixed assists not being awarded to dead players
[/list] 

[h1]Team Auto-Assign[/h1]

On community request, players are now automatically assigned to a team by default in TDM, GTTC, and CTE. Once assigned to that team, there is no option to switch teams. This should go a long way to prevent the famous “Dino-Hogging” issue. This also removes spectator on servers using Team Auto-Assign, which prevents even more exploits. 

If you are a server owner and you wish to disable this, add this to the startup commandline:

[code]?bAutoAssignTeam=false[/code]

[h1]Economy and Store[/h1]

With this update, we've added over 60 new community items from the Workshop!

To support this huge addition of items, we're bringing back the popular Christmas Gift in the form of the Summer Gift 2016 for a limited time!

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/Store7_Landscape.jpg[/img]

In addition to this, we've added a new Workshop Celebration Crate. This crate has it's own key, which is now in the store. The store also has a limited time item and two new bundles:

[img]http://www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/Store8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hunt Update 1.5.0 Now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://i2.wp.com/www.primalcarnage.com/wp-content/uploads/HuntUpdate1024.jpg?fit=1024%2C643[/img]

[b]Las Vegas, NV - April 17th, 2016[/b] - An update to Primal Carnage: Extinction has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Primal Carnage: Extinction. The major changes include:


[b][h1]Hunt[/h1][/b]

Phoenix Corporation has been experimenting with cloaking technology that allows a special breed of Novaraptor to become invisible! Fortunate for the engineers involved in the project but unfortunate for you, this new tech has a side effect of making these specimens more deadly. 

In this gamemode, one player is randomly chosen to be the cloaked Raptor. The Hunt Raptor's objective is to take out a team of humans. If the humans survive for 5 minutes, they win! If the Hunt Raptor kills off the whole team, the Hunt Raptor wins and gets to be the Raptor again. If a human kills the Hunt Raptor, that human becomes it.


[b][h1]Workshop Celebration Crate & Key[/h1][/b]

We're celebrating the overwhelming success of Steam Workshop support with our first Community Crate! This crate contains 10 items created by our community - 5 uncommons, 3 rares, and 2 legendary items. You can unlock this crate with the new Workshop Celebration Crate Key, and a percentage of these sales go straight to the community content creators. In addition, the Workshop's most popular item- The "Female Alpha Novaraptor", is now available in the store...but only until May 1st. Get it while you can!

Along with these items, workshop creators Kordak and Talon have provided us with 8 free skin drops! 


[b][h1]Stat Track[/h1][/b]

Ever wish you could do more to let other players know you're the best? Now you can! With Stat-Track items, every kill gets logged in the item's description for everyone to see. As you get more kills, your Stat-Track item will reach milestones and the prefix name of your item will change to match (For example - Vicious Steel Leopard Novaraptor). Stat-Track items are currently only available in special Stat-Track crates, including the new Workshop Celebration Crate. 


[b][h1]Spectator UI, Dominations, Gameplay Feed[/h1][/b]

When spectating a player during a match, you now have access to new information. This includes their Steam avatar, current health, currently equipped item, and how many times you've killed them vs you. Over time we plan on updating this with even more information. 

Additionally, when you kill a player a certain number of times you're now Dominating that player- and the server lets everyone know it.

Finally, we have a new gameplay feed that sits below the timer on the HUD. This feed updates you with relevant gameplay events. 


[b][h1]Human Skin Bases[/h1][/b]

In the next day or so, we'll be releasing skin bases for all of the human characters. Making full human skins has never been easier! 


[b][h1]Changelog[/h1][/b]


[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*]Added Hunt
[*]Added new Spectator UI
[*]Added Dominations
[*]Added Gameplay Feed
[*]Added Workshop Celebration Crate with 10 new items
[*]Added Female Alpha Novaraptor to Store
[*]Added 8 skin drops 
[*]Generally improved server chat logging
[*]Freeroam now properly logs chat messages
[*]Fixed a Steam DLL causing some dedicated servers to not advertise
[*]Fixed certain achievements not updating correctly
[*]Fixed map rotation not working correctly in some gamemodes
[*]Fixed the server gamemode not carrying over after a map change
[*]Fixed being able to vote for maps meant for a different gamemode
[*]Fixed an issue where controls would stay locked after death
[*]Fixed a start-up crash for players at certain low resolutions
[*]Fixed -queryport launch parameter not existing
[/list]


[b]Dinosaur[/b]

[list]
[*]Raptor/Oviraptor no longer freezes at the end of a maul
[*]Improved reliability of Ptera/Tupa roar 
[*]Decreased Raptor/Oviraptor jump delay slightly
[*]Decreased Dilo/Cryo jump delay slightly
[*]Increased Carno acceleration closer to original values 
[*]Increased Carno charge damage
[*]Increased Ptera AirSpeed from 300 to 400 
[*]Increased Tupa AirSpeed from 350 to 450
[*]Fixed Raptor/Oviraptor floating during a maul
[*]Fixed the Raptor/Oviraptor regenerating stamina during a maul
[*]Fixed dinosaurs being able to heal while netted, on fire, or flying
[*]Fixed T-Rex not consuming stamina during special attacks
[*]Fixed 3rd person dilo poison effect showing in 1st person
[/list]


[b]Human[/b]

[list]
[*]Rehauled melee system to increase reliability 
[*]Passive melee can now be used while reloading, firing, or scoping
[*]Explosive weapons now deal 50% damage to their owners 
[*]Explosives no longer do damage to other humans
[*]Drastic Molotov Cocktail improvements
[*]Removed headshot damage from all shotguns
[*]Removed SPAS12 double-shot secondary
[*]Increased Passive Melee damage from 50 to 75
[*]Increased StunGun effective range from 768 units to 1280 units
[*]Increased Trapper Melee bonus to netted/stunned enemies (Now instakill)
[*]Increased Machete damage from 100 to 180
[*]Increased SPAS12 rate of fire
[*]Decreased SPAS12 damage from30 per shell to 20
[*]Fixed missing healing sounds when a human uses a health station
[*]Fixed Pyro chainsaw dealing damage to targets behind him
[*]Fixed Flaregun missing an impact sound
[*]Fixed audio issues with the dynamite
[*]Fixed some human character textures being low-resolution 
[/list]

[b]Maps[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed bad spawnpoints on FR-Island 
[*]Fixed Airbase helipad being see-through from below
[*]Fixed some trees in snow maps having the wrong material
[*]Improved Tyrant/Carno collision in several maps
[/list]


Thanks to [url=http://primalcarnageforums.com/member.php?1672-Moxxie]Moxxie[/url] for the header image!
